title: Controls Engineer, Amazon Data Services, Inc
descriptionHtml:
As part of the global controls team, you will work with highly motivated experts and innovators in the data center industry. You will be responsible for troubleshooting, project management, and maintaining the building management system (BMS) and electrical power monitoring system (EPMS). Using Amazon leadership principles, you will develop new processes and standards while innovating in the controls space. AWS Data centers have multiple components such as generators, uninterruptable power sources, diesel generators, electrical switchgear, power distribution units, variable frequency drives, automatic/static transfer switches, chillers [air-cooled and water-cooled], pumps, cooling towers, heat exchangers, CRAHs, air economizers, etc. All these components have local control systems that interact with each other via open and/or proprietary communications protocols. The BMS is the primary method of control of all mechanical systems within a data center. The EPMS is the primary method of monitoring all electrical systems within a data center.

Key job responsibilities
• Troubleshoot and perform Root Cause Analysis or Corrective Action for BMS and EPMS related issues in AWS data centers.
• Train and assist internal customers and stakeholders with the creation, design, configuration, validation, installation, commissioning and operation of BMS and EPMS systems.
• Provide technical assistance and support to operations during life cycle of the data center.
• Review results and action items from the quarterly maintenances for BMS and EPMS and take actions to get them resolved.
• Develop BMS & EPMS projects scope of work, schedule, budget, and level of efforts (LOE) to projects requested by customers and stakeholders.
• Manage scope, schedule, finance and execution of BMS and EPMS improvement projects in AWS data centers.
• Assist in procurement related activities including request for quotation/proposals, responding to request for information, review of vendors proposal and issuance of purchase orders.
• Participate in AWS global on-call schedule to provide immediate BMS and EPMS technical support to in-service data centers.
• Attend project related meetings, coordinate with project leaders and regularly report status to Controls and stakeholders management.
• Support Controls projects related commissioning activities in the data centers.
• Review, implement, troubleshoot and iterate on the controls sequence of operation (SOO) and provide necessary feedback to the design team.
• Develop and modify controls logic programming and graphical user interfaces.
• Manage multiple stakeholder deliverables, requirements and navigate challenging situations.
• Financially manage BMS and EPMS service contracts.
• Frequently visit (locally) assigned in-operation data centers to troubleshoot, meet customers, supervise vendor’s work to ensure compliance with the scope, design, SOO and applicable local codes.

About the team
About the team
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional

title: System Development Engineer, Astra ADC
descriptionHtml:
This is an excellent opportunity to join Amazon's world-class technical team at HQ2 in Arlington, VA, working with some of the best and brightest engineers while developing your skills and furthering your career within one of the most innovative technology companies anywhere.

Amazon Software Builder Experience (ASBX) Astra ADC provides the foundational services that every Amazon builder depends on to develop, deploy, and operate software from continuous deployment orchestration to testing infrastructure and configuration management. Our team owns and operates critical ASBX services across Amazon's most secure and isolated environments, including Apollo (deployment), Pipelines (continuous delivery), Test on Demand/Hydra (integration testing), AppConfig (feature management), Multi-Region (resource replication), Builder MCP, and AIM (AI agent infrastructure). We ensure these services maintain parity, reliability, and security across all partitions.

A successful Engineer joining the team will do much more than write code and triage problems. They will operate services at scale in air-gapped environments where standard commercial tooling doesn't exist, drive cross-partition deployment parity, and build the automation that keeps Amazon's most sensitive workloads shipping safely. They will dive deep into complex distributed systems issues and work diligently to improve the builder experience.

The ideal candidate will:

- Be great fun to work with. Our company credo is "Work hard. Have fun. Make history." The right candidate will love what they do and instinctively know how to make work fun.
- Have strong Linux & Networking Fundamentals. The ideal candidate will have deep experience working with Linux, preferably in large-scale, distributed environments. You understand networking technology, how services communicate across isolated boundaries, and regularly take part in deep-dive troubleshooting and technical post-mortem discussions to identify root causes of complex issues.
- Love to code. Whether it's building deployment automation, creating AI-powered operational tooling, or solving complex cross-partition orchestration problems, the ideal candidate will love using technology to solve problems. You have a solid understanding of software development methodology and CI/CD practices.
- Think Big. The ideal candidate will build and deploy solutions that enable thousands of Amazon builders to ship software reliably across multiple isolated regions. You will strive to improve and streamline processes to allow delivery at massive scale.
This position requires that the candidate selected must currently possess and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance. The position further requires that, after start, the selected candidate obtain and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance with polygraph or commensurate clearance for each government agency for which they perform AWS work.


A day in the life
You start the morning reviewing deployment health across isolated regions, checking alarms and on-call handoffs. Mid-morning, you're deep in a code review for a cross-partition automation fix, then jump into a design discussion on how to bring a new ASBX service capability to air-gapped environments. After lunch, you troubleshoot a deployment pipeline issue, tracing it from orchestration logs to a configuration mismatch, and ship the fix before end of day. Between the technical depth and the autonomy to own problems end-to-end, no two days look the same.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

title: HR Associate Partner, PXT
descriptionHtml:
**Dies ist ein 2-Jahres-Vertrag.**

Im Streben danach, der beste Arbeitgeber der Welt zu sein, treiben unsere globalen Human-Resources-Teams – bekannt als People eXperience and Technology (PXT) – den Unternehmenserfolg voran, indem sie eine sichere, inklusive und innovative Unternehmenskultur fördern. Die Rolle des Associate Partners bietet einen Einstieg in den HR-Bereich bei Amazon und konzentriert sich auf grundlegende HR-Prozesse sowie die direkte Unterstützung der Mitarbeitenden. Der Associate Partner sorgt für außergewöhnliche Mitarbeitererlebnisse, indem er sowohl menschliche Expertise als auch technologische Lösungen einsetzt. Er verwaltet wesentliche HR-Transaktionen und baut gleichzeitig bedeutungsvolle Verbindungen zu Mitarbeitenden in einem zunehmend digitalen Arbeitsumfeld auf. Diese Rolle ergänzt Amazons sich weiterentwickelnde PXT-Servicekanäle – von KI-gestützten Systemen bis hin zu persönlichen Supportoptionen – indem sie dort personalisierte Unterstützung und menschliche Nähe bietet, wo diese am wertvollsten sind. Durch die effektive Balance zwischen technologiegestützten Prozessen und bedeutungsvoller Interaktion tragen sie dazu bei, ein nahtloses PXT-Erlebnis zu schaffen, das Amazons Engagement, der beste Arbeitgeber der Welt zu sein, weiter stärkt.

Zu deinen Hauptaufgaben gehören die Bearbeitung von HR-Transaktionen, das Management von Zeit- und Anwesenheitsfragen sowie die grundlegende Unterstützung der Mitarbeitenden – bei komplexeren Anliegen erfolgt die Weiterleitung an erfahrenere Kolleginnen und Kollegen. Je nach Bedarf bist du als Associate Partner für mehrere Standorte innerhalb deiner geografischen Region (Cluster) zuständig und fungierst als erste Anlaufstelle für grundlegende HR-Anfragen. Als Associate Partner im One PXT Team trägst du dazu bei, durch jede Interaktion ein herausragendes Mitarbeitererlebnis zu gestalten. Die Rolle erfordert eine einladende und zugängliche Präsenz sowie die präzise und zeitnahe Unterstützung der Mitarbeitenden zu Themen wie Benefits, Unternehmensrichtlinien und Gehaltsabrechnung.

Du wirst vor Ort an einem Amazon-Standort arbeiten. Bedarfsorientiert unterstützt du temporär auch umliegende Standorte.


Key job responsibilities
• Reaktionsschnelle, freundliche und professionelle Unterstützung der Mitarbeitenden über verschiedene Kanäle (persönlich, digital, per E-Mail, telefonisch) – mit genauen und zeitnahen Informationen zu Benefits, Richtlinien, Gehaltsabrechnung und weiteren HR-relevanten Themen.
• Sicherstellung der Genauigkeit, Integrität und Vertraulichkeit von Mitarbeiterdaten durch die sorgfältige und sichere Pflege und Verarbeitung von Unterlagen.
• Beitrag zu einer positiven und inklusiven Unternehmenskultur durch die Unterstützung und Umsetzung von Mitarbeiterengagement- und Anerkennungsinitiativen – einschließlich der Planung und Durchführung von Veranstaltungen, die den Zusammenhalt fördern und Leistungen würdigen.
• Unterstützung datenbasierter Entscheidungsfindung durch die Erhebung, Prüfung und Analyse wichtiger Personalkennzahlen, darunter Anwesenheit, Fluktuation und Engagement.
• Zusammenarbeit mit Führungskräften und Supportteams, um Mitarbeitende über KI-gestützte und klassische Self-Service-Tools sowie HR-Ressourcen zu informieren und zu schulen – mit dem Ziel, das Mitarbeitererlebnis und die betriebliche Effizienz zu verbessern. Nutzung von KI als primäres Hilfsmittel bei der Recherche und Problemlösung sowie proaktiver Einsatz verfügbarer Ressourcen und interner Netzwerke.
• Erstellung und Veröffentlichung klarer, professioneller interner Kommunikation für Mitarbeitende und Führungskräfte unter Einhaltung der organisatorischen Standards und des gewünschten Kommunikationsstils.
• Erkennung und Weiterleitung komplexer oder sensibler Anliegen an die zuständigen HR- und Führungsverantwortlichen – darunter Gehaltsabweichungen, Dienstplanungskonflikte, Anträge auf Anpassungen am Arbeitsplatz, Schwerbehindertenangelegenheiten, Abwesenheitsfragen, Vorwürfe von Fehlverhalten, Richtlinienverstöße, rechtliche oder betriebsrätliche Anliegen sowie weitere Mitarbeiterbeziehungsthemen.


A day in the life
Ein typischer Arbeitstag umfasst die Unterstützung von Mitarbeitenden bei der Nutzung unserer digitalen HR-Tools und Self-Service-Plattformen sowie die Bereitstellung reaktionsschneller und professioneller Hilfe bei Bedarf. Du verbringst Zeit auf der Betriebsfläche, coachst Mitarbeitende im effektiven Umgang mit HR-Technologie, beantwortest Fragen zu Richtlinien und Programmen und erkennst Möglichkeiten zur Verbesserung der Self-Service-Nutzung. Unter Anleitung erfahrener Teammitglieder stellst du eine genaue Dateneingabe und Dokumentation sicher und leistest dabei einen außergewöhnlichen Service, der Vertrauen und Sicherheit aufbaut.

Im Laufe deiner Schicht bearbeitest du HR-Transaktionen mit verschiedenen Tools und Systemen, verfolgst Servicekennzahlen und vertiefst dein Verständnis des HR-Betriebs. Bei komplexen Anfragen triffst du fundierte Entscheidungen über geeignete Eskalationswege und arbeitest eng mit erfahrenen Teammitgliedern an der Lösung zusammen.

Für den Erfolg in dieser Rolle sind eine ausgeprägte Serviceorientierung, Sorgfalt, ausgezeichnete Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und die Fähigkeit zur Wahrung der Vertraulichkeit erforderlich. Durch praktische Erfahrung in dieser Einstiegsposition entwickelst du grundlegende HR-Kompetenzen und trägst gleichzeitig zu positiven Mitarbeitererlebnissen bei.

Amazon Operations ist eine 24/7-Umgebung, und Schichten können sich je nach Geschäftsbedarf ändern. Für diese Rolle ist die Bereitschaft zur Arbeit in flexiblen Schichten – einschließlich Wochenenden, Abendschichten und rotierenden Dienstplänen – erforderlich. Amazon übernimmt keine Verantwortung für aufenthaltsrechtliche Genehmigungen, einschließlich H-1B, TN und anderer Nicht-Einwanderungsvisa, für diese Stelle.

About the team
Unser Team unterstützt Fulfillment Center und Delivery Stations in Deutschland. Wir arbeiten direkt mit Mitarbeitern, Managern und verschiedenen Abteilungen zusammen, um eine faire und inklusive Arbeitsumgebung zu schaffen. Als Associate Partner wirst du der erste Ansprechpartner für Mitarbeiterfragen – deine Arbeit verbessert direkt ihre Erfahrung und Zufriedenheit. Wir lösen echte Probleme: Konflikte klären, Karrieren unterstützen, faire Prozesse sichern. Das Team ist unterstützend und kollegial. Du wirst Teil einer Mission, die Menschen wirklich im Mittelpunkt stellt.

Basic qualifications

- Abitur oder gleichwertiger Abschluss
- Grundlegende Kenntnisse in Microsoft Office (z. B. Erstellen von Dokumenten in Word, Nutzung grundlegender Tabellenfunktionen in Excel, Verwaltung von Kalendern und E-Mails in Outlook)
- Fähigkeit zur Wahrung der Vertraulichkeit im Umgang mit sensiblen Informationen
- Erfahrung in der effektiven Kommunikation mit unterschiedlichen Zielgruppen (z. B. Erklären von Prozessen, Eingehen auf Anliegen, Bereitstellung fachlicher Orientierung)
- Fließende mündliche und schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Deutsch und gute Englischkenntnisse

Preferred qualifications

- Berufserfahrung im Bereich Human Resources oder Kundenservice mit nachgewiesenen Erfolgen in der Problemlösung
- Ausgeprägte zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten mit nachgewiesener Kompetenz im Anleiten und Unterstützen Anderer
- Fähigkeit, Mitarbeitende effektiv in der Nutzung verschiedener HR-Technologien und digitaler Plattformen zu schulen, anzuleiten und zu unterstützen – mit Fokus auf die Steigerung der Nutzerakzeptanz und Verbesserung der Anwendererfahrung
- Fähigkeit, mehrere Prioritäten zu managen und Deadlines einzuhalten
- Bachelor-Abschluss oder gleichwertige Qualifikation

title: Senior Technical Program Manager, Region Services
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Web Services provides a highly reliable, scalable, low-cost infrastructure platform in the cloud that powers hundreds of thousands of businesses in 190 countries around the world. To meet the growing demand for AWS Services within the US government and air-gapped regions, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people. If you have strong program management, IT infrastructure and/or programming experience, and can communicate highly technical concepts to audiences at different stages in the AWS journey, we’d like to speak with you.

We are looking for a dynamic, organized Senior Technical Program Manager (TPM) to join AWS to manage AWS delivery of solutions in support of US Government customers. In this role, your primary responsibility will be supporting the delivery of technical solutions for government contracts. You will provide support and coordination responding to customer inquiries and translating customer requirements into technical requirements. You will also have the opportunity to enhance internal processes, programs and measures to drive growth and efficacy.

You will join a team of senior and principal product managers and TPMs who support our AWS government regions and contracts. The team is responsible for building and executing strategies for a delightful customer experience across multiple regions and driving business results.

As a TPM, you will have the opportunity to work closely with AWS leadership and Service Teams to sequence, report upon, and deliver services and features in government and air-gapped regions. You will collaborate and align with a specific set of AWS service teams and deliver mechanisms for services across this specified set of regions. You will collaborate with Service Teams to deliver solutions that make efficient use of resources and technologies, identifying dependencies that need to be addressed within these regions. You will assess risks, anticipate issues, overcome technical obstacles, make difficult trade-off decisions, and balance business needs and technical constraints.

Successful candidates will have a a background working with AWS services, familiarity with their architecture, strong background in program management supporting technical programs. They must be detail oriented, have excellent problem-solving abilities, and experience working with Public Sector customers in the Defense or National Security industries.

You will successfully represent program status to AWS senior leadership. Your program management expertise and operational excellence will influence the team’s decisions and drive secure and scalable solutions. You should be passionate about delivering great customer experiences and researching and developing new delivery methodologies.

This position requires that the candidate selected must currently possess and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance. The position further requires the candidate to opt into a commensurate clearance for each government agency for which they perform AWS work.


Key job responsibilities
Senior TPMs work with our external customers and internal AWS Service teams to understand the requirements of our customers from an end-to-end process. Their work lessens the burden across engineering teams and improves the customer experience. They serve as mentors to stakeholders unfamiliar with the NatSec customer experience and work with customer-facing account teams to align unique requirements with how AWS delivers and operates our services globally.

A day in the life
Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
 
AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS)
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
 
Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
 
Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
 
Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
 
Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

About the team
Our team indexes high on earns trust, are right a lot, and insists on the highest standards. We work collaboratively across the broader organization to pull in the right subject matter experts, principles, and engineering teams to deliver results for our customers. We work diligently to navigate public sector regulatory requirements with the scale of commercial cloud.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of technical product or program management experience
- 7+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
- 5+ years of technical program management working directly with software engineering teams experience
- Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
- Current, active US Government Security Clearance of Top Secret with SCI eligibility or above

Preferred qualifications

- 5+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
- Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules
- Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership
- 5+ years of senior level leadership support, or 7+ years of Amazon experience

title: Ingénieur(e) DCEO , Data Center Engineering Operations
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Web Services recherche des personnes motivées, rigoureuses et passionnées par les infrastructures techniques pour rejoindre nos équipes en tant qu'Ingénieur(e) en Exploitation des Centres de Données (DCEO). Ce poste offre une opportunité passionnante d'intégrer une équipe dédiée à la fiabilité et à la disponibilité des infrastructures critiques d'AWS, au service de millions de clients à travers le monde.

AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS)
AWS Infrastructure Services est responsable de la conception, de la planification, de la livraison et de l'exploitation de l'ensemble de l'infrastructure mondiale d'AWS. En d'autres termes, nous sommes les personnes qui font fonctionner le cloud. Nous soutenons l'ensemble des centres de données AWS ainsi que tous les serveurs, équipements de stockage, réseaux, systèmes d'alimentation électrique et de refroidissement qui garantissent à nos clients un accès continu aux innovations sur lesquelles ils comptent. Nous travaillons sur les problèmes les plus complexes, avec des milliers de variables impactant nos opérations, et nous recherchons des talents qui souhaitent nous aider à relever ces défis.

Vous rejoindrez une équipe diversifiée composée d'ingénieurs logiciels, matériels et réseau, de spécialistes des systèmes critiques, d'experts en sécurité, de responsables des opérations et d'autres rôles essentiels. Vous collaborerez avec des collègues à travers AWS pour maintenir les plus hauts standards de sécurité tout en fournissant une capacité apparemment infinie au coût le plus bas possible pour nos clients. Vous évoluerez dans une culture inclusive qui accueille les idées audacieuses et vous donne les moyens de les mener à terme.

Nous recherchons actuellement un(e) Ingénieur(e) DCEO pour assurer le support technique des infrastructures critiques au sein de l'un de nos centres de données. Ce poste contribue à garantir la disponibilité et la fiabilité de l'ensemble des infrastructures électriques et mécaniques dans un environnement de centre de données. Ces équipements supportent des serveurs critiques et doivent maintenir un taux de disponibilité supérieur à 99,999 %. Le rôle requiert une personne autonome, capable de prendre des initiatives et de proposer des solutions efficaces face à des problèmes techniques complexes. Les candidats retenus auront un impact direct et immédiat sur la résilience, l'efficacité et la capacité de nos installations, notamment en assurant la maintenance, l'exploitation et le dépannage des infrastructures critiques : groupes électrogènes diesel de secours et systèmes de carburant associés, systèmes électriques triphasés (tableaux de distribution, onduleurs, PDU, batteries, etc.), systèmes de refroidissement (CRAC, refroidisseurs centrifuges, tours de refroidissement, traitement chimique de l'eau, centrales de traitement d'air), pompes et moteurs.


Key job responsibilities
• Exploiter et maintenir l'ensemble des équipements mécaniques, électriques et CVC (chauffage, ventilation, climatisation) du centre de données.
• Superviser les prestataires intervenant pour des opérations de maintenance ou de maintenance préventive.
• Élaborer des plans d'intervention pour les réparations d'urgence sur les actifs critiques.
• Travailler en autonomie, avec un minimum de supervision directe.
• Assurer des astreintes et participer à un planning de rotation selon les besoins opérationnels.
• Appliquer les concepts de support de base : systèmes de ticketing, analyse des causes racines, priorisation des tâches.
• Effectuer des permanences selon le planning défini.
• Respecter scrupuleusement l'ensemble des procédures et politiques de sécurité physique.
• Veiller au strict respect des procédures de sécurité lors de l'exécution des travaux.
• Réaliser l'installation des alimentations en rack, le remplacement des PDU et ATS de rack.
• Vérifier les capacités électriques et de refroidissement avant toute installation de nouveau rack.
• Créer et clôturer les ordres de travail avec les données appropriées (heures de main-d'œuvre, maintenance des équipements, pièces utilisées) dans le système de gestion des actifs.
• Enregistrer les changements d'état dans les infrastructures critiques dans le cadre des opérations de maintenance corrective et préventive.
• Effectuer des tests de qualité, de performance, de sécurité et de fiabilité des produits, équipements et processus.
• Intervenir en première ligne pour le dépannage des équipements électriques et mécaniques : unités de traitement d'air (UTA), refroidisseurs, tours de refroidissement, systèmes de traitement chimique, pompes, moteurs, variateurs de vitesse (VFD) et systèmes de gestion technique du bâtiment (GTB).
• Définir et maintenir les standards les plus élevés en matière de sécurité, et promouvoir activement une culture de sécurité de classe mondiale dans tous les aspects des procédures opérationnelles.
• Piloter les efforts d'amélioration continue des infrastructures par la standardisation des procédures et des politiques, tout en assurant la performance selon les indicateurs définis.
• Permettre à l'organisation des opérations d'atteindre 100 % de disponibilité sur l'ensemble des infrastructures supportant les clients.
• Collaborer efficacement avec les parties prenantes internes et externes pour garantir l'excellence opérationnelle pour tous les clients AWS.
• Assurer la planification et l'exécution de la maintenance préventive des infrastructures critiques selon les procédures AWS.
• Assurer la supervision et le monitoring des installations (via GTB, PMS, rondes de surveillance, etc.).
• Participer activement à la livraison des projets de construction et de rénovation des infrastructures des centres de données.
• Garantir la capacité de l'organisation à réagir de manière appropriée à tout événement susceptible d'impacter les clients, sur tout composant électrique ou mécanique.
• Analyser les rapports d'incidents, documenter les tendances périodiques et formuler des recommandations à la direction.
• Rédiger, mettre à jour et maintenir les modes opératoires, les procédures standard d'exploitation (SOPs), les procédures d'urgence, les programmes de maintenance préventive et l'ensemble de la documentation technique relative au DCEO.


About the team
Pourquoi AWS ?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) est la plateforme cloud la plus complète et la plus largement adoptée au monde. Nous avons été pionniers du cloud computing et n'avons jamais cessé d'innover — c'est pourquoi les clients, des startups les plus prospères aux entreprises du Global 500, font confiance à notre gamme robuste de produits et services pour alimenter leurs activités.

Expériences diversifiées
Amazon valorise les expériences diversifiées. Même si vous ne répondez pas à toutes les qualifications et compétences préférées énumérées dans la description du poste, nous vous encourageons à postuler. Si votre carrière débute, n'a pas suivi un parcours traditionnel ou inclut des expériences alternatives, ne laissez pas cela vous empêcher de postuler.

Culture d'équipe inclusive

title: Applied Science Manager, Translation Services
descriptionHtml:
Have you ever wondered how Amazon launches and maintains a consistent customer experience across hundreds of countries and languages it serves its customers? If so, we have an exciting opportunity for you!
Translation Services is seeking an Applied Science Manager to own the technical vision and multi-year science roadmap spanning machine translation, multimodal content (image translation, video subtitling), and automated quality evaluation. This leader will manage scientists and MLEs, define research direction for novel problem spaces with limited industry precedent, and bridge science breakthroughs into production-ready systems operating at Amazon scale.

As a leader of the Science team of TS, this person will be responsible for leading their team in designing algorithmic solutions based on data and mathematics for translating billions of words annually across 130+ and expanding set of locales. The goal is to build solutions with minimal human touch involved in any language translation and ensure accurate translated text is available to our worldwide customers in a streamlined and optimized manner.

With access to vast amounts of data, technology, and a diverse community of talented individuals, you will have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on the way customers and stakeholders engage with Amazon and our platform worldwide. This role requires strong technical skills, a deep understanding of machine learning approaches, and a solid grasp on NLP and LLM techniques to solve complex language translation challenges. You must have a demonstrated ability for optimizing, developing, launching, and maintaining large-scale production systems.

As a key member of the team, you will oversee all aspects of the software lifecycle: design, experimentation, implementation, and testing. You should be willing to dive deep when needed, move rapidly with a bias for action, and get things done. You should have an entrepreneurial spirit, know how to deliver, and long for the opportunity to build pioneering solutions to challenging problems. This role will demand resourcefulness and willingness to learn on both the technical and business side.


Key job responsibilities
In this role, you will work closely with business partners, applied scientists, software development engineers, and product managers to accelerate building solutions to expand translation capabilities. You will have significant influence on our overall strategy by helping define science and engineering strategy, define product features, drive system architecture, and spearhead the best-practices that enable a quality product. You will also influence the development processes, and develop well-rounded skills such as leadership, and effective project management. Building a strong development team and developing career plans for the scientists and engineers reporting to you will be a key responsibility. Throughout, you should possess creativity, curiosity, and excellent judgment to thrive in an environment of ambiguity.

A day in the life
You will spend your days collaborating with scientists, developers, customers, stakeholders, and converting the business needs into a data-driven solution. You will support a team to design and execute science products. You will dive deep into the data and balance technical execution with longer term strategy. You will grow and develop your team.

About the team
Translation Services is entering a phase where the problems ahead are fundamentally different from the problems we've solved. Our text translation stack is production-grade and serving 30+ language pairs across Retail. But the next frontier — image translation, video subtitle localization, long form text and automated quality evaluation — represents novel research problems at Amazon scale with limited industry precedent.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of scientists or machine learning engineers management experience
- Knowledge of ML, NLP, Information Retrieval and Analytics

Preferred qualifications

- Experience building machine learning models or developing algorithms for business application
- Experience building complex software systems, especially involving deep learning, machine learning and computer vision, that have been successfully delivered to customers

title: Sr. Mechanical Design Engineer, Worldwide Grocery Real Estate Growth & Development (WWRGD)
descriptionHtml:
Join us as we redefine the future of physical retail! Our goal is to be Earth's most customer-centric company and we're just getting started. We are looking for people who want to join a newly developing business unit full of ambitious and driven professionals that continue to push the boundaries of reality and improve the daily lives of our customers.

This team is seeking a Refrigeration Engineering Standards Program Manager with expertise in Refrigeration and Control systems who will manage the building systems engineering standards for developing prototypes and ongoing construction projects. This position will serve as a department expert and act as a "bridge" between the department and the broader organization. The position requires strong working knowledge in a wide variety of building types and systems (both the design of such systems and also installation and maintenance) with a focus on refrigeration design and controls.

This is a high-visibility, high-impact role for someone who is energized by building structure where there is ambiguity, who can translate complex technical requirements into clear standards, and who thrives in an organization where influence matters more than authority.

Key job responsibilities
Engineering Design Standards Ownership:
- Own refrigeration engineering design standards.
- Establish and maintain standards with cross-functional partners, including basis of design (BOD) for technical disciplines to meet company criteria and cost targets.
- Manage equipment specifications and design coordination.

Technical Innovation & Cost Management:
- Execute refrigeration cost reduction, energy conservation, and sustainability goals.
- Lead technical innovation initiatives for building systems and quality control.

Consultant & Vendor Management:
- Cultivate relationships with 3P engineering consultants and manage production of engineering documents.
- Track consultant quality and cost, own relationships with MEP/R and Controls consultants.

Quality Assurance & Technical Support:
- Conduct site inspections and facility audits. Provide technical expertise to Pre-Construction, Design, Construction, Facilities, and Operations teams.
- Support preventative maintenance SOPs and partner with Facilities to ensure systems align with established standards.

Cross-Functional Collaboration:
- Serve as SME for Refrigeration and Controls topics.
- Work cross-functionally to share best practices, provide engineering solutions for site-specific designs, and review construction documents for accuracy and cost targets.
- Proven ability to efficiently plan and prioritize deliverables and resources across multiple projects
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills
- Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
- Demonstrated ability to make creative design recommendations and articulate technical justification to diverse stakeholders

A day in the life
You will partner with 3P engineering consultants to develop programmatic Refrigeration design guardrails and articulate design justification to different groups within the organization. You will value-engineer Refrigeration systems and reduce overall program costs while ensuring the customer experience is not affected. You will attend meetings as required to address specific issues, make decisions and find solutions quickly and with confidence. You will take ownership of your work, display a great deal of initiative, and exercise sound judgment.

About the team
The WWRGD Design Standards Team develops and maintains integrated design standards and programmatic design resources for Amazon's retail portfolio enabling architects of record and contractors to efficiently deliver consistent, high-quality store environments at scale. Our products include specifications , construction assemblies, reference architectural sets, and digital tools including Revit/BIM resources. We support all store formats, from Daily Shops to Large Format Suburban stores and new exploratory formats, and we coordinate alignment across format-specific brand experiences.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Technology, or Reliability Engineering, or 6+ years of refrigeration industry experience
- 6+ years of refrigeration industry experience
- Strong working knowledge of building systems design, installation, and maintenance with focus on refrigeration design and controls
- Experience with value engineering and cost reduction while maintaining quality standards
- Experience managing stakeholder expectations, schedules, budgets, and scopes
- Experience managing 3P engineering consultants

Preferred qualifications

- Professional Engineer (PE) license
- Experience with Amazon or retail construction projects
- Experience with commissioning standards and processes
- Knowledge of sustainability, energy conservation, and carbon reduction strategies

title: Responsable de Maintenance Industrielle (F/H), Maintenance, Robotique & Systèmes Automatisés
descriptionHtml:
Construisez l'avenir d'Amazon dès la première pierre.

Nous lançons un nouveau site à Derval (entre Rennes et Nantes) en fin2027, et tout reste à bâtir. Dès le premier jour, vous serez au cœur de l'action : de l'installation des équipements à la définition des premiers standards opérationnels, vous poserez les fondations de ce qui deviendra un maillon essentiel de notre réseau logistique.

Pour en savoir un pue plus, voici un article qui parle du projet !: https://www.aboutamazon.fr/actualites/activite-logistique/amazon-annonce-la-construction-de-son-premier-centre-de-distribution-dans-la-region-pays-de-la-loire-a-derval-loire-atlantique-qui-creera-1-000-emplois-en-cdi

Au sein de l'équipe RME (Reliability Maintenance Engineering), vous intégrerez le moteur de l'innovation chez Amazon. Notre mission ? Faire en sorte que chaque outil, chaque technologie, chaque système évolue au rythme d'Amazon pour garantir que des millions de clients reçovent leurs commandes à temps, chaque jour.

En tant que Responsable Maintenance Industrielle & Robotique, vous dirigerez une équipe de superviseurs et de techniciens expérimentés. Vous évoluerez dans un environnement où l'excellence opérationnelle n'est pas une ambition, mais une exigence et où chacune de vos décisions impacte directement la satisfaction de nos clients.

Si vous êtes passionné(e) par les défis techniques de haut niveau, le management d'équipes expertes et l'innovation concrète au quotidien, alors ce poste est fait pour vous.

Key job responsibilities
- Assurer la santé et la sécurité de votre équipe : Déployer une culture de sécurité exemplaire (protocoles LOTO, Safety Curriculum, toolbox talks), maintenir l'objectif zéro incident grave, et faire de la santé et sécurité un levier de performance durable sur votre site
- Développer et faire grandir vos talents : Coacher techniciens, superviseurs et apprentis dans leur progression, piloter les programmes RMEO et d'apprentissage, et créer un environnement où chacun se sent soutenu et reconnu
- Garantir l'excellence opérationnelle : Piloter la disponibilité technique des équipements (objectif >99%), planifier la maintenance préventive dans le cadre des processus établis, et contribuer à la réduction des High Impact Events et False Fire Alarms
- Piloter l'amélioration continue et l'innovation : Exploiter les outils d'IA (dont Quartz, notre agent IA de diagnostic déployé sur 600+ sites dans le monde), analyser les données pour identifier les opportunités d'optimisation, et mener des projets Kaizen/QCC en lien avec les équipes européennes
- Gérer les projets et les parties prenantes : Collaborer avec les équipes internes (GES, GPO, Central RME) et les fournisseurs tiers, élaborer des plans opérationnels pour améliorer la productivité et l'efficacité dans le cadre des objectifs du réseau

A day in the life
Vous serez basé·e sur l’un de nos sites opérationnels, ce qui vous permettra d’être au plus près de votre équipe et d’avoir une vision claire de ce qui se passe sur votre site. Vous collecterez des données et résoudrez les problèmes dans un environnement dynamique. Vous aurez également l’occasion d’élaborer un plan opérationnel visant à rendre le site plus productif et plus efficace. Vous devrez notamment mettre en place de nouveaux projets visant à améliorer les processus opérationnels et l’entretien du matériel. Après la sécurité, la fonction la plus importante de votre rôle consistera à diriger votre équipe et à gérer ses performances et son évolution, notamment en mettant en place des formations.

About the team
Notre équipe d’ingénieurs RME (Reliability Maintenance Engineering) veille à ce que nos équipements fonctionnent au mieux. Guidés par des responsables expérimentés, nous sommes une équipe à l’esprit analytique. Nos collaborateurs·trices possèdent à la fois des connaissances techniques poussées et un bon esprit d’équipe. Nous travaillons ensemble pour assurer l’entretien, le dépannage et la réparation des ressources de notre réseau mondial de centres d’expédition. Certains de nos employé·es occupent des postes à responsabilités et sont chargés de superviser l’équipe dans son travail sur des technologies passionnantes, dont certaines n’existent que chez Amazon.
De l’installation de systèmes d’emballage automatisés à la supervision de la maintenance générale d’un site, en passant par la réparation d’équipements de distribution essentiels, notre équipe assure le bon fonctionnement de la plupart des éléments techniques d’Amazon. Nous veillons, par exemple, à ce que les bâtiments soient conformes à la législation, afin d’assurer la sécurité de tous et le fonctionnement à plein régime de nos sites. Les possibilités d’évolution sont nombreuses, tant au sein de l’équipe RME qu’à l’échelle d’Amazon.
Tout ce que nous faisons vise à réduire les temps d’arrêt dans les principaux sites logistiques d’Amazon, afin que les clients reçoivent leurs commandes à temps. Nous travaillons souvent tôt ou tard pour effectuer les tâches de maintenance avec un minimum de perturbations, y compris en équipes de nuit. Si nous voyons qu’il existe une méthodologie plus aboutie pour faire les choses, nous avons les compétences nécessaires pour développer et introduire des processus nouveaux ou des technologies de pointe, comme Amazon Robotics ou notre robot de tri ultra sophistiqué.

Basic qualifications

- Une expérience préalable au sein d'une équipe de maintenance dans un environnement industriel ou de production/logistique qui gère des processus complexes et variés
- Une expérience préalable dans la gestion d'une équipe d'ingénieurs/techniciens
- Une expérience préalable en tant qu'agent de liaison et de gestion des relations entre diverses parties prenantes/fournisseurs tiers
- Maîtrise du français (CEFR C1 ou supérieur) et maîtrise de l'anglais (CEFR B2 ou supérieur, oral et écrit)
- Connaissance des règlementations statutaires telles que les contrôles de conformité et les protocoles de sécurité des machines

Preferred qualifications

- Connaissance des équipements automatisés, notamment des machines d'emballage et des systèmes de tri et de convoyage
- Connaissance des outils d'analyse de données et des systèmes de contrôle basés sur des automates programmables
- Expérience préalable dans la gestion de projets ou des processus Kaizen, Lean, Six Sigma
- Connaissance des systèmes de gestion de la maintenance assistée par ordinateur (GMAO)

Nous prenons nos décisions de recrutement en fonction de votre expérience et de vos compétences. Nous apprécions votre envie de découvrir, d'inventer, de simplifier et de construire. title: Procurement and Supplier Development Manager, AIS Supply Chain- IPS: Procurement
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Amazon Web Services provides a highly reliable, scalable, and low-cost cloud platform that powers thousands of businesses in over 190 countries. AWS’ Infrastructure Supply Chain & Procurement organization works to deliver solutions to source, build and maintain our socially responsible data center supply chains. We are a team of highly-motivated, engaged, and responsive professionals who enable the core sustainable infrastructure of AWS. Come join our team and be a part of history as we deliver results for the largest cloud services company on Earth!

The IPS Procurement Category Management Org is responsible for the procurement of all third party provided services required for the operation of our Data Center infrastructure globally, including Colo and Edge facilities for externally delivered services not provided by the facility owner. The team is responsible for the identification, on boarding and performance management of suppliers as well as developing category strategies, conducting competitive tendering processes, supplier negotiations and the preparation of associated Work Orders.

The team is structured into three regions, each led by a regional manager, with each regional team composed of category managers with responsibility for the management of specific areas of spend within the region and a cohort of procurement specialists who support the category managers. The category management approach facilitates a strategic approach to procurement by facilitating in depth market analysis coupled with a cross functional approach to identify supplier and associated contracting options which are focused on meeting the particular needs of the business. Category management moves beyond traditional transactional based purchasing negotiations to provide a strategic approach to longer term, sustainable cost reductions, reducing risk and increasing resiliency in the supply base and facilitating innovation from within the supply base that the business can leverage.
While cost reduction will always be a key focus of the team, the principle cynosure of the team is the delivery of services that are keenly focused on increasing reliability and supporting enhanced availability through robust relationships which support continuity of operations. As service and quality levels can vary greatly, principally based on the skill set within a supplier local organization, the regional structure facilitates tailoring of category strategies to meet local market considerations and closely monitor supplier performance at the local level.


Key job responsibilities
The ideal candidate thinks long term, drives multiple initiatives, and communicates appropriately and influences customers and suppliers at all levels. You must be collaborative, but also work with significant autonomy. To be successful in this role you must be highly analytical; think strategically and globally; have a sense of urgency to meet customer timelines; exhibit curiosity and learning drive; succeed in a fast-paced environment; engage and influence key stakeholders; and have a high level of customer focus and business judgement. Also, you must have a demonstrated track record of managing multiple projects and driving them to completion to meet business objectives. It will be critical to embrace and model Amazon’s Leadership Principles and have an entrepreneurial spirit with a “get it done” mentality.

•Manage a complex category within the Maintenance, Repair, and Operation (MRO) and Facility Management domains.

•Achieve cost savings through bidding and negotiations, drive collaboration to achieve long term value delivery.

•Obtain market intelligence, analyze category data and metrics to drive Procurement category strategies.

•Understand trends in customers’ needs and concerns, across categories and regions, to influence customers’ priorities.

•Lead supplier selection process across multiple sub-categories, internal teams, and regions, and create longer-term supplier selection strategies for management.

•Ensure you are knowledgeable about the supply market, new innovations and supplier capabilities, technically and geographically.

•Ensure you are knowledgeable about sustainability, diversity, in-country value and have experience developing category strategies to incorporate same.

•Develop mechanisms and metrics to track supplier performance related to delivery, quality, and cost.

•Create supplier scorecards to measure and track supplier performance.

•Lead business reviews to discuss best practices and issues and to ultimately improve supplier performance and strengthen business partnerships.

•Innovate within the procurement space, automating and/or improving tools or processes to better support the Procurement Lifecycle.

•Provide support throughout the contracting process, as well as SRM and management of contracts post-execution.

Travel domestic and international as required.


About the team
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences.

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

title: Manager, Electrical & Controls Engineering , OneMHS - Electrical and Control Engineering, Arch and Design
descriptionHtml:
We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Manager, Electrical & Controls Engineering to lead and manage the electrical power systems and controls engineering function within One MHS (One Material Handling Systems). This role will be responsible for overseeing the complete design, development, and implementation of electrical power distribution and control systems for material handling projects — while leading a team of engineers to deliver solutions that prioritize safety, scalability, and operational excellence. As part of OneMHS, you will shape how we design, build, and operate material handling capabilities through strategic leadership in electrical and controls engineering.

The ideal candidate will have a proven track record in electrical power system design, controls engineering, industrial communication protocols, and automation platforms for complex material handling systems including conveyance and sortation — combined with demonstrated leadership experience managing engineering teams. You will drive cross-functional collaboration with mechanical engineering, software, and project management teams to deliver robust electrical and controls solutions while ensuring compliance with NEC code and industry standards.

This role requires both deep technical expertise spanning electrical power design and controls engineering, and strong people leadership skills — including the ability to build high-performing teams, set strategic direction, manage resources, and drive organizational excellence in project delivery.


Key job responsibilities
Leadership & Team Management

• Lead, mentor, and develop a team of electrical and controls engineers, fostering a culture of technical excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement
• Set strategic direction for the electrical and controls engineering function, aligning team objectives with broader OneMHS program goals
• Manage resource allocation, workload balancing, and project assignments to ensure on-time, high-quality delivery across multiple concurrent projects
• Conduct performance reviews, career development planning, and talent acquisition for the electrical and controls engineering team
• Establish and enforce engineering standards, design review processes, and quality gates across the team
• Drive organizational improvements including process optimization, tool adoption, and knowledge management initiatives
• Represent the electrical and controls engineering function in leadership meetings, program reviews, and strategic planning sessions

Power Systems Design & Distribution

• Oversee the design of all power and controls systems related to MH projects, including 3-phase and single-phase power distribution systems
• Direct the development of electrical layouts, schematics, control architectures, and panel standardization for material handling applications
• Ensure modular and scalable power distribution system designs that prioritize reliability, maintainability, and performance
• Establish and maintain best practices for panel placement, grounding, and safety circuit design
• Approve single-line diagrams, power distribution schematics, and panel schedules to support facility and equipment power needs

Controls Engineering & Communication Protocols

• Oversee the design and implementation of industrial communication networks utilizing EtherCAT, Ethernet/IP, and PROFINET protocols
• Direct control system architecture development incorporating IPCs (Industrial PCs), PLCs (Programmable Logic Controllers), and SCADA systems
• Ensure proper specification, configuration, and integration of Variable Frequency Drives (VFDs) and their associated interfaces within material handling systems
• Oversee the selection, specification, and integration of sensors, encoders, safety circuits, and all safety devices in accordance with applicable safety standards
• Ensure the design and implementation of safety systems including light curtains, safety relays, E-stops, and safety PLCs meet all regulatory requirements

In-Field Installation Audits & Compliance

• Establish audit programs and oversee in-field installation audits to verify compliance with design specifications, quality standards, and NEC code requirements
• Review and approve electrical and controls drawings, specifications, and submittals at a program level
• Drive continuous improvement by auditing electrical system designs to identify opportunities and develop superior solutions
• Ensure all designs and installations comply with the National Electrical Code (NEC) / NFPA 70 and other applicable standards
• Stay current with NEC code revisions, NFPA updates, and industry regulatory changes, and communicate impacts to the team

Collaboration & Strategic Engagement

• Partner with cross-functional leadership including mechanical engineering, software, and project management to deliver fully integrated solutions
• Serve as the primary technical authority and escalation point for electrical and controls engineering decisions
• Drive commissioning strategy, troubleshooting protocols, and startup activities across projects
• Develop and maintain electrical and controls design standards, best practices, and organizational playbooks
• Build relationships with vendors, suppliers, and external partners to drive innovation and cost optimization

Your combination of technical and audit background will help bridge security, technology, and compliance, and facilitate the scale of the program.

The successful candidate is one who loves working across many stakeholders, including internal and external customers, to design solutions for complex compliance challenges. You are passionate about the security of the cloud and you want to solve real business problems.

We have a team culture that encourages ownership, diversity, inclusion, and innovation. We expect this person to balance their unique perspective with those of the diverse perspectives of the team and its stakeholders. As part of the team, you will work with customers and regulators to demonstrate Amazon security controls applicable to local requirements. title: Ontologist, Product Knowledge
descriptionHtml:
The vision of the Product Knowledge Ontology Team is to provide a standardized, semantically rich, easily discoverable, extensible, and universally applicable body of product knowledge that can be consistently utilized across customer shopping experiences, selling partner listing experiences and internal enrichment of product data. We aim to make product knowledge compelling, easy to use, and feature rich. Our work to build comprehensive product knowledge allows us to semantically understand a customer’s intent – whether that is a shopping mission or a seller offering products. We strive to make these experiences more intuitive for all customers.

As an Ontologist, you work on a global team of knowledge builders to deliver world-class, intuitive, and comprehensive taxonomy and ontology models to optimize product discovery for Amazon web and mobile experiences. You collaborate with business partners, data science and engineering teams to deliver knowledge-based solutions to enable product discoverability for customers. In this role, you will directly impact the customer experience as well as the company’s product knowledge foundation.

Key job responsibilities
* Develop logical, semantically rich, and extensible data models for Amazon's expansive product catalog
* Ensure our ontologies provide comprehensive sub-domain coverage that are available for machine ingestion and inference
* Research worldwide understanding of Amazon products to develop scalable data models that solve customer problems and enhance product discoverability
* Create new schema using Generative Artificial Intelligence (generative AI) models
* Expand existing data retrieval techniques by utilizing our extensive product catalog and query languages
* Analyze website metrics and product discovery behaviors to make data-driven decisions on optimizing our knowledge graph data models globally
* Contribute to the development of new tool features and processes for the Ontology team
* Drive alignment to ontology modeling and technology best practices and principles within our organization and across Amazon
* Coordinate cross-functional projects with a broad range of technical and non-technical teams

About the team
Our team has a global presence: we celebrate diverse cultures and backgrounds within our team and our customer base. We are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion, offering continuous access to internal affinity groups as well as highlighting diversity programs. We care about your career growth, from your initial company introduction and training sessions, to continuous support throughout your entire career at Amazon. We recognize each team member as an individual, and we will build on your skills to help you grow. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we are building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing.

Basic qualifications

- Experience building ontologies, taxonomies, and semantic relation frameworks
- Degree in Library Science, Information Systems, Linguistics or equivalent professional experience
- 3+ years of relevant work experience working in ontology and/or taxonomy roles
- Proven skills in data retrieval and data research techniques
- Ability to quickly understand complex processes and communicate them in simple language
- Ability to communicate knowledge-based requirements and needs to engineering and retail teams
- Familiarity with Semantic Web technologies (RDF/s, OWL), query languages (SPARQL) and validation/reasoning standards (SHACL, SPIN)
- Knowledge of open-source and commercial ontology engineering editors (e.g. Protégé, TopQuadrant products, PoolParty)
- Detail-oriented problem-solving, ability to work in fast-changing environment and manage ambiguity
- Proven track record of strong communication and interpersonal skills

Preferred qualifications

- Master’s degree in Library Science, Information Systems, Linguistics or other relevant fields
- Experience building ontologies in the e-commerce and semantic search spaces
- Experience working with schema-level constructs (e.g. higher-order classes, punning, property inheritance)
- Familiarity with software engineering life cycle

As a Data Center Commissioning Engineer (CxE), you will be part of highly creative, efficient team tasked with tackling fascinating and challenging problems building and supporting the operations of Amazon owned data centers. The Amazon Commissioning team (ACx) understands, evaluates, defines and manages the expectations of construction quality in accordance to engineering designs to meet the customer requirements. The CxE is responsible for supporting vendors, contractors, and other teams involved in the construction and commissioning of various systems such as:

-Medium and low voltage power systems
-Generators
-UPS
-HVAC (Air Handlers / Exhaust Fans / VFD)
-Chilled Water Systems
-Building Management systems (BMS)
-Electrical Power Monitoring Systems (EPMS)
-Testing and balancing
-Pumps and Hydronic systems

Physical Requirements
Walk job sites in uneven terrain
Work at heights and from ladders
Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl
Lift and/or move up to 49 pounds; and participate in group lifts for 50 pounds or more
Carry objects weighing up to 49 pounds for short distances
Work shifts longer than eight hours in duration with potential for night and weekends
Perform physical tasks throughout the day without becoming overly tired
Ability to manipulate small wires and objects easily
Work in a noisy environment
Work in environments that are colder or hotter than a normal office environment

Additional Job Requirements
· Ability and willingness to travel domestic and internationally for up to 80% of the year.
· Required to provide personal transportation for meetings and job visits away from the office; reimbursed.
· US Citizenship required

Key job responsibilities
The Commissioning Engineer (CxE) provides testing and validation oversight of AWS data center electrical and mechanical infrastructure. CxEs review design documents, lead Factory Witness Testing (FWT), and manage third-party commissioning vendors in the performance of onsite pre-functional, functional, and integrated systems testing. They take Ownership of their projects’ successes by Diving Deep to resolve technical issues and having Bias for Action to address everchanging schedule and coordination demands onsite. Additionally, CxEs communicate lessons learned and continuously collaborate on program improvements.

The CxE shall provide multi-discipline input into the scheduling, test script development, designing, and planning of projects. In addition, the CxE will be required to review component submittal packages, lead Factory Witness Testing (FWT), perform system level and integrated system testing. During commissioning the CxE will continuously audit activities to ensure compliance with environmental, quality, and safety requirements. Additionally, the individual will be responsible for comprehensive weekly reporting of status of all ongoing projects and lessons learned to continually improve the quality of our program. This position will include coverage of multiple inflight projects and tight timelines.

A day in the life
On a typical project, the CxE works across AWS engineering, capacity delivery, operations, and contractor teams to coordinate site activities, prioritize tasks, and ensure each issue has clear path to resolution. The CxE manages the project commissioning vendor whose primary scope is to identify issues, determine criticality, propose solutions, and document their findings. If project turnover is at risk, the CxE escalates to the appropriate stakeholders. Upon project completion, the CxE will communicate lessons learned to help peers on similar projects in flight and participate in initiatives that drive improvement to the commissioning program.

title: Software Development Manager, WWGST
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's Worldwide Grocery Stores-Tech (WWGST) team is looking for an experienced Software Development Manager.

Ever wonder how millions of grocery products get correctly identified, enriched, and made available to customers — both on shelves and online? That's the problem we're solving, and we need a software development manager to lead the team doing it.

Here's what makes this role unique: you'll lead engineers who build systems at the intersection of machine learning and product data quality. Your team uses large language models, automated ML, and real-time data from third-party providers to answer questions like "which product does this barcode actually belong to?" and "are the temperature, expiry, and dimension attributes for this item correct?" These aren't theoretical problems — when we get them wrong, products spoil, customers get the wrong item, and supply chains break down.

You'll own the end-to-end technical strategy for catalog data accuracy across grocery. That means distributed systems processing millions of records, ML pipelines that train and infer on weekly cadences, and data integrations with external providers across multiple countries. You'll also build internal tools that put catalog intelligence directly in the hands of business teams.

Key job responsibilities
- Lead a team of engineers building and operating distributed systems that process millions of product records across grocery marketplaces.
- Own the technical vision for resolving product identity defects — where a single barcode incorrectly maps to multiple products — using data matching, third-party OCR sources, and scoring algorithms.
- Drive the evolution of ML infrastructure — including scheduled training/inference pipelines, LLM-based attribute validation, and automated publishing workflows.
- Guide the strategy for ingesting, transforming, and synchronizing third-party product data into the catalog across international marketplaces.
- Build and maintain internal tooling that gives product managers and business users visibility and control over grocery catalog operations.
- Make architectural decisions for scaling early-stage systems while ensuring operational excellence across multiple AWS accounts and regions.
- Translate complex supply chain and catalog business requirements into concrete technical solutions — prototyping rapidly and iterating with cross-functional partners.
- Partner with applied science teams on ML model development and product ionization.
- Foster an entrepreneurial engineering culture focused on innovation, ownership, and high-velocity delivery.
- Mentor and develop engineers, promoting technical excellence and career growth.

About the team
This is a small, entrepreneurial team where everyone wears many hats. You'll have the freedom to define architecture, influence product direction, and ship solutions that directly impact how Amazon and Whole Foods Market source and sell groceries. If you want a role where you can see your work on store shelves the same week you deploy it — this is it.

Basic qualifications

- 8+ years of leading the definition and development of multi tier web services experience
- 7+ years of engineering experience
- 3+ years of engineering team management experience
- Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software/hardware/networks development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, certification, and livesite operations
- Experience partnering with product or program management teams
- Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in communicating with users, other technical teams, and senior leadership to collect requirements, describe software product features, technical designs, and product strategy
- Experience in recruiting, hiring, mentoring/coaching and managing teams of Software Engineers to improve their skills, and make them more effective, product software engineers

This role requires deep technical mastery of 3GPP control and user plane protocols, extensive experience with 4G/5G Handset launch, product lifecycle and device portfolio management, and the ability to translate customer experiences and user stories into detailed product requirements. The Senior Product Manager - Technical (PMT) will be at the forefront of defining NTN device requirements and building 0-to-1 satellite systems for consumer, business, and government customers globally.

title: Audit & Compliance Manager, Transportation Risk and Compliance (TRC)
descriptionHtml:
Amazon’s Transportation Risk & Compliance (TRC) team identifies and mitigates risk in a rapidly growing and complex, global environment. To support the business, our primary mission is to perform independent and objective, risk-based assessments of Amazon business partners’ activities and related controls with the goal of improving operations, compliance, risk management, and overall success of the program. We provide Audit & Monitoring (A&M) support of high-risk transportation risk topics to drive compliance across the transportation programs and influence business controls.

We are seeking an experienced professional in audit, risk, controls, governance and program management, to join our Australia (AU) TRC Last Mile (LM) Field Operations (FO) team, to lead and execute Audit & Monitoring (A&M) across AU LM transportation programs. In this role, you will work closely with Amazon's AU LM transportation businesses to plan, scope, and execute audits to verify carrier partners are meeting legal and contractual obligations relating to business practices, driver / provider eligibility, and safety standards. You will be expected to apply risk and control concepts to new and existing business models, clearly and concisely communicate identified findings to carrier partners, and internally report audit results in a timely and effective manner. You will provide carriers with consultative support to identify opportunities for improvement, develop corrective action plans to address audit defects, and manage those remediation plans to closure. You will also work collaboratively with the operations, business, safety, legal, public policy, finance, and tech teams to implement world-class, customer-centric, compliance and risk management solutions. To bring in best practices and learning, you’ll also work with and learn from colleagues globally.

This is a small but growing team, meaning you'll play an instrumental role in developing the function, defining and developing the value that we offer to our business partners, and how we achieve strategic goals, in a business which continues to grow rapidly.

This role can be based in Sydney NSW or Melbourne VIC.

Key job responsibilities
Transport is a wide discipline, and you will have an opportunity to learn about a range of disciplines, such as employment law, safety, driver licensing, etc, in addition to performing periodic site visits.

• Manage and oversee end-to-end execution A&M programs to determine if third-party transportation partners are compliant with contractual and regulatory requirements.
• Liaise with Global Quality team to ensure alignment to global audit quality standards and metrics
• Manage A&M findings, ensuring closure, or enforcement actions if they are not closed on time.
• Collate and provide regular reporting of A&M metrics for local and global reporting
• Perform deep dives of processes to identify risks, controls, and gaps, and use that information to influence business
• Independently manage the yearly audit plan, and own the end-to-end audit lifecycle
• Define A&M program scope and tests for new LM programs engaging with key stakeholders including business, operations, legal, public policy, and other compliance teams.
• Manage relationships with cross functional stakeholders internal and external to Amazon
• Scale audits through automation and AI.
• Advise the business on risk and compliance issues for new transportation initiatives, processes, risks and controls and building solutions despite ambiguity.
• Deliver quality, business-oriented reports that are written with practical, actionable, and value-added recommendations

A day in the life
Audit & Compliance Managers engage with Carrier Partners, plan, scope, execute, and report on the audit outcomes. The individual provides consultative support and guidance on corrective actions to Carrier Partners and verifies remediation. Audit & Compliance Managers will also consult with business, legal, and tech teams to develop gap remediation strategies and the build-out of sustainable and systematic solutions. The individual will work effectively in a team environment and, as individual contributors, be able to work remotely and effectively review the work of other remote team members.

About the team
Transportation Risk and Compliance (TRC) is the voice of risk and compliance for Amazon’s transportation businesses across 24+ countries. We proactively identify and manage risks through risk mitigation strategies and provide assurance that Amazon and our carrier partners comply with the highest transportation and legal standards (including legislative, regulatory, and contractual). Anchored by sound subject matter expertise, processes, and growing technology solutions, our TRC leaders improve public safety and enable business growth as we work diligently to serve our customers.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent experience)
- 3+ years of experience in auditing, risk management, compliance, program management, or quality management systems
- 3+ years of program or project management experience
- Experience establishing successful partnerships with internal and external teams to execute tactical initiatives or equivalent
- Experience of interacting regularly and directly with senior executives.
- Ability to independently manage a project and demonstrate sound judgment even in ambiguous situations
- Ability to turn complex compliance requirements into scalable processes

Preferred qualifications

- Professional auditing qualification, or similar risk or compliance credentials
- Experience with SQL and Excel
- Knowledge of retail food code and regulations governing grocery retail at local, state, and federal levels
- Experience in accounting management in Big Four with Fortune 500 clients, or experience in tax, finance or a related analytical field
- Knowledge of payroll and the modern awards system, and third-party risk management
- Experience working in the operations, transportation, and logistics sectors.
