descriptionHtml:
About Maintenance at Amazon

Operations is at the heart of Amazon’s business. We are known for our speed, accuracy, and exceptional service. Our buildings deliver tens of thousands of products to hundreds of countries worldwide, every day. Reliability Maintenance & Engineering (RME) are the business partners that work tirelessly behind the scenes to make it all happen. We drive continuous improvement and maintain all of the Robotics and Material Handling Equipment (MHE) to ensure our customers are met with the Amazon smile. Come join us on our journey!

About the Role

As a Mechatronics & Robotics Technician, you will use your skills to support the Operations Maintenance team in repairing and maintaining material handling equipment and pneumatic systems throughout the building. You will have the opportunity to install, maintain, and repair automated packaging and distribution equipment. In addition to developing your skills, you will mentor junior technicians to grow in their roles.

What Do We Offer?

Amazon offers competitive compensation packages including comprehensive healthcare benefits starting on Day 1, matching 401(k) program, and up to 20 weeks of paid parental leave. But wait, there is more: We provide lightweight fire-resistant daily wear and composite toe safety shoes for your safety!

Here is what you can expect with the Reliability & Maintenance Engineering (RME) selection process for Mechatronics & Robotics Technicians: (Timeframe: Approximately 30-days)

Step 1: Congratulations! You successfully submitted your application!

Step 2: Amazon Recruiting will review your application and invite the most qualified candidate to complete a pre-employment assessment.

Step 3: If you meet the role qualifications, you will receive an invitation from Amazon Recruiting (do-not-reply@criteriacorp.com) to begin your Criteria assessment. You have 5 days to complete.

Step 4: Once you successfully meet the pre-employment assessment requirements, you will be invited to complete a video interview. Your video interview invitation will be from HireVue (interviews@hirevue.com) and you will have 7 days to record your interview.

Step 5: Your video interview will be reviewed by the Amazon Hiring Team and you will be notified of next steps via email within 5 business days.


Key job responsibilities

- You will promote a safe working environment by following all safety procedures

- You will troubleshoot electrical and mechanical problems related to all Material Handling Equipment (MHE) which includes belts, motors, photo-eyes, relays, and more

title: Machine Learning Engineer, SageMaker AI Inference
descriptionHtml:
Demand for large language model (LLM) inference is growing fast, and the engineers who make it faster and more efficient are shaping the future of AI at Amazon. We are looking for a Software Development Engineer to focus on inference performance optimization, kernel tuning, and LLM serving efficiency. You will work across the full software development lifecycle to design, build, and measure systems that reduce latency and improve throughput for production inference workloads. This is a hands-on engineering role where your work directly translates into better performance for internal teams and, ultimately, for Amazon's customers. If you are an engineer who enjoys profiling bottlenecks, writing high-performance code, and finding elegant solutions to hard systems problems, we want to talk to you.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and implement kernel-level optimizations and inference pipeline improvements that reduce latency and increase throughput for LLM serving workloads.
- Profile, benchmark, and tune model inference performance across hardware and software stacks, identifying bottlenecks and delivering measurable gains.
- Write well-organized, maintainable code and participate actively in code reviews, providing constructive feedback to peers and mentoring newer engineers on the team.
- Collaborate with applied scientists, ML engineers, and infrastructure teams to translate model requirements into production-ready inference solutions.
- Evaluate emerging tools, frameworks, and generative AI techniques for inference optimization, recommending adoption where they improve efficiency or quality.

A day in the life
You might start your morning reviewing benchmark results from an overnight profiling run, then dig into a kernel implementation to shave milliseconds off a critical inference path. After lunch you could pair with an applied scientist to understand a new model architecture's compute profile and plan your optimization approach. Throughout the day you will participate in code reviews, document your design decisions, and share findings with the broader team so that improvements compound across projects.

About the team
Our team owns SageMaker AI inference at Amazon, and inference performance optimization is becoming increasingly important as LLM workloads scale. Performance optimization is one of our key differentiators, and every improvement we ship has a direct impact on cost, speed, and the experience our customers receive. We value collaboration, technical depth, and a culture where every engineer's perspective is heard. If you want to solve hard systems problems in an environment that rewards curiosity and rigorous engineering, this is the team for you.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- 1+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience
- 1+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience
- 1+ years of Object Oriented Design experience
- Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with CUDA kernels or ML/low-level kernels
- Experience with Machine Learning and Large Language Model fundamentals, including architecture, training/inference lifecycles, and optimization of model execution

title: Gestionnaire des Ressources Humaines - CDD, Associate Partner, PXT
descriptionHtml:
CDD de 6 mois à pourvoir sur le rôle de gestionnaire des ressources humaines, sur le site de Gidy

Dans notre quête d'être le Meilleur Employeur au Monde, nos équipes mondiales des Ressources Humaines, connues sous le nom de People eXperience and Technology (PXT), contribuent au succès de l'entreprise en favorisant une culture fondée sur la sécurité, l’inclusivité et l’innovation. Le rôle de RH Partenaire Associé(e) constitue un point d'entrée dans les équipes RH chez Amazon, axé sur les processus RH de base et le soutien direct aux employés. Le/la RH Partenaire Associé(e) offre des expériences collaborateurs de qualité en combinant expertise humaine et solutions technologiques. Il/Elle gère les demandes RH essentielles tout en établissant des liens étroits avec les employés dans un environnement de travail de plus en plus numérique. Ce rôle vient compléter les canaux de service PXT en constante évolution d'Amazon — des systèmes enrichis par l'IA aux options d'assistance en direct — en apportant une aide personnalisée et une dimension humaine là où elles sont les plus précieuses. En équilibrant efficacement les processus assistés par la technologie avec des interactions essentielles, il/elle contribue à offrir une expérience PXT fluide qui renforce l'engagement d'Amazon à être le Meilleur Employeur au Monde.



Vos principales responsabilités comprennent le traitement des demandes RH, la gestion des problèmes de temps et de présence, ainsi que l’apport d'un soutien de base aux employés, en faisant remonter les questions complexes au personnel de niveau supérieur. Les HR Partenaire Associé(e)s peuvent soutenir plusieurs sites au sein de leur région géographique et constituer le principal point de contact pour les demandes RH de base. En tant que HR Partenaire Associé(e) au sein de l'équipe One PXT, vous contribuerez à offrir une expérience collaborateur exemplaire à travers chaque interaction. Ce rôle implique de maintenir une présence accueillante tout en fournissant des informations précises et en temps opportun sur les sujets liés aux avantages sociaux, aux politiques et à la paie.

Vous devrez travailler sur site dans un établissement Amazon.

Key job responsibilities
· Fournir un soutien réactif, cordial et professionnel aux employés via différents canaux (en personne, par e-mail, par téléphone), en communiquant des informations précises et en temps opportun sur les avantages sociaux, les politiques, la paie et d'autres sujets liés aux RH.

· Garantir l'exactitude, l'intégrité et la confidentialité des données des employés en maintenant et en traitant les dossiers de manière sécurisée et dans les délais impartis.

· Contribuer à une culture de travail positive et inclusive en soutenant et en mettant en œuvre des initiatives d'engagement et de reconnaissance des employés, notamment en planifiant et en organisant des événements favorisant la cohésion et célébrant les réussites.

· Soutenir la prise de décision fondée sur les données en collectant, en examinant et en analysant les indicateurs clés de nos collaborateurs notamment l'assiduité, l'attrition et l'engagement.

Travailler en partenariat avec les managers et les équipes de support pour encourager et accompagner les collaborateurs dans l’usage des outils en libre-service, qu’ils soient pilotés par l’IA ou traditionnels, et des ressources RH, afin d’optimiser l’expérience collaborateur et la performance opérationnelle. Anticiper et résoudre les problématiques en tirant parti de l’IA comme premier levier, tout en mobilisant activement les ressources internes et les réseaux existants. Préparer et diffuser des communications internes claires et professionnelles à l'intention des employés et des responsables, en veillant à leur conformité avec les standards et le ton de l'organisation.

· Identifier et faire remonter les questions complexes ou sensibles aux responsables RH et aux responsables métiers concernés — telles que les écarts de rémunération, les conflits d'horaires, les demandes d'aménagement, les questions d'invalidité, les questions de congé, les soupçons de mauvaise conduite, les violations de politique, les préoccupations légales ou liées aux instances représentatives du personnel, et autres problématiques de relations sociales.

A day in the life
Une journée type consiste à aider les employés à naviguer dans nos outils RH numériques et plateformes en libre-service, tout en fournissant un soutien réactif et professionnel lorsque nécessaire. Vous passerez du temps sur le terrain, accompagnant les collaborateurs dans l’utilisation efficace des technologies RH, répondant à leurs questions sur les politiques et programmes, et identifiant des opportunités pour améliorer l’adoption du libre-service. Sous la supervision de membres Seniors de l'équipe, vous veillerez à l'exactitude des saisies de données et de la documentation, tout en fournissant un service irréprochable qui renforce la confiance et la sérénité de vos collaborateurs.



Tout au long de votre journée de travail, vous traiterez des demandes RH à l'aide de divers outils et systèmes, en suivant les indicateurs de service tout en développant votre compréhension des opérations RH. Lorsque des demandes complexes se présentent, vous ferez preuve de discernement pour déterminer les moyens les plus appropriées pour les remonter et collaborerez efficacement avec les membres seniors de l'équipe pour leur résolution.

La réussite dans ce rôle requiert une forte orientation service client, le souci du détail, d'excellentes compétences en communication et la capacité à préserver la confidentialité. Grâce à une expérience pratique dans ce poste de niveau débutant, vous développerez des compétences RH fondamentales tout en contribuant à des expériences collaborateurs positives.

Les Opérations Amazon fonctionnent 24h/24 et 7j/7, et les horaires peuvent être modifiés en fonction des besoins de l'entreprise. La capacité à travailler selon des horaires flexibles, y compris les week-ends, les soirées et des rotations, est requise pour ce poste. Amazon ne parraine pas les demandes d'immigration, y compris pour les visas H-1B, TN et autres visas non-immigrants, pour ce poste.

title: EHS Specialist
descriptionHtml:
Join Amazon’s mission to become Earth’s safest place to work! At Amazon, we’ve set the ambitious goal to become the benchmark of safety excellence across all industries in which we operate. As a Workplace Health & Safety Specialist (WHSS), you'll be at the forefront of transforming workplace safety culture at one of the world's most innovative companies. Your expertise and dedication will directly protect employees, ensuring they return home safely to their families every day. You'll facilitate new approaches to safety, combining technology with human-centered solutions to create an environment where safety and productivity thrive together. This isn't just about maintaining safety standards – it's about revolutionizing how we think about and implement workplace safety, making a lasting impact on our people and operations. As your building's designated safety champion, you'll have the unique opportunity to build relationships, influence positive change, and help write the next chapter in Amazon's commitment to becoming Earth's Safest Place to Work.

Safety Program Excellence & Implementation - Drive comprehensive safety programs through data-driven strategies. Lead daily safety audits, incident investigations, and risk assessments while implementing innovative solutions to prevent injuries. Deliver engaging safety training that resonates with associates and promotes a proactive safety culture. Champion continuous improvement initiatives that enhance workplace safety while maintaining operational efficiency.

Foster a culture where safety is everyone's priority through effective communication, coaching, and positive reinforcement. title: Applied Scientist II
descriptionHtml:
Every year, Amazon's operations depend on hiring hundreds of thousands of hourly associates across the globe, and your work will determine how efficiently and effectively that happens. We are looking for a curious, resourceful Applied Scientist to tackle multi-objective optimization problems worldwide. In this role, you will build mathematical models and AI/ML systems that optimize recruitment processes under real-world cost, capacity, and regulatory constraints across North America and beyond. This is a particularly exciting time to join because we are expanding into new countries, building AI-native capabilities, and beginning to externalize our solutions so that teams beyond our own can benefit from the tools we create. You will partner with economists, machine learning engineers, and analytics engineers to turn theory-based decision models into production systems that improve candidate experience and business outcomes at a scale few teams can offer.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and implement optimization algorithms and mathematical models that determine optimal job posting timing, candidate management strategies, and recruitment coordination across multiple countries and markets.
- Develop and maintain conversion models, demand forecasting systems, and multi-objective optimization frameworks using machine learning, survival analysis, and causal inference techniques.
- Plan and run controlled experiments to validate new recruitment mechanisms, measure their impact, and iterate on model performance using real-world data.
- Write production-quality code in Python, applying optimal data structures and algorithms while making practical tradeoffs between complexity, memory efficiency, and maintainability.
- Collaborate with generation, hiring event, and coordination teams to integrate your models into automated hiring pipelines, and contribute to the team's scientific agenda through peer reviews, mentorship, and publications.

A day in the life
You might start your morning reviewing model performance dashboards and conversion metrics, then refine a stochastic dynamic programming model that balances hiring demand against cost constraints for an upcoming peak period. After lunch, you could be designing an A/B test for a new candidate management strategy or pairing with another scientist to incorporate local market regulations into an optimization framework. You will regularly present findings in science reviews and help shape the team's research roadmap.

About the team
Our team sits within Amazon's operations organization and owns the science behind converting job applicants into hired associates at a global scale. We support leadership teams across North America and beyond, building the optimization and ML systems that keep fulfillment centers staffed and ready to serve customers. Right now we are investing in AI-native automation, expanding our models to additional countries, and making our tools available to partner teams across the organization. The team is a multidisciplinary group of scientists, economists, machine learning engineers, and analytics engineers who collaborate closely to solve problems that span economic theory, statistical modeling, and large-scale engineering. We value rigorous experimentation, collaborative problem-solving, and a shared commitment to improving both business outcomes and the candidate experience.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of building models for business application experience
- Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language
- Experience building machine learning models or developing algorithms for business application
- Experience in designing experiments and statistical analysis of results
- Experience in solving business problems through machine learning, data mining and statistical algorithms
- Experience in state-of-the-art deep learning models architecture design and deep learning training and optimization and model pruning

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in professional software development
- Master's degree or above in econometrics, statistics, industrial engineering, operations research, optimization, data mining, analytics, or equivalent quantitative field
- Experience applying theoretical models in an applied environment

title: Hardware Support Engineer, RDPI Global Engineering Hardware Development
descriptionHtml:
Are you inspired by invention? Is problem solving through teamwork in your DNA? Do you like the idea of seeing how your work impacts the bigger picture? Answer yes to any of these and you'll fit right in here at Amazon Robotics.

We are a smart team of doers who work passionately to apply advances in robotics and software to solve real-world challenges that will transform our customers' experiences in ways we can't even imagine yet. We invent every day. We are Amazon Robotics and we will give you the tools and support you need to invent with us in ways that are rewarding, fulfilling, and fun.

Job Overview

Amazon Robotics Delivery and Packaging Innovation (RDPI) Global Engineering Hardware team is seeking a motivated and hands-on Hardware Support Engineer to join our GE HW Field Service Tech team. This team operates in a multi-disciplinary environment alongside hardware engineers, controls engineers, test engineers, and test technicians dedicated to advancing sustainable packaging automation and robotics technologies that fulfill millions of customer orders every day.

In this role, you serve as the vital link between lab/on-site field testing activities and the RDPI GE HW Test Engineering team, ensuring maximum performance and reliability of advanced packaging automation and robotics systems during testing, deployment, and validation. You will provide hands-on troubleshooting and repair support of RDPI hardware platforms, including Universal SmartPac (USP), Olympus, Velocity, and Gen14 - to name a few - across laboratory and field environments during R&D, design verification, and production deployment phases. Working hand-in-hand with Test Technicians and Test Engineers, you will support site acceptance testing (SAT), design verification testing (DVT), and execute hardware troubleshooting, equipment recovery, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement initiatives across Amazon's fulfillment network.

You will develop and implement diagnostic solutions, escalation processes, standard operating procedures, and preventative maintenance protocols for the RDPI hardware product suite. You will proactively monitor system performance, identify trends, and provide "voice of the field" feedback to development and test engineering teams. This role requires independent judgment and comfort working with ambiguity in a complex, fast-paced, high-throughput environment where multi-tasking is essential.

Key job responsibilities
Provide on-site hands-on troubleshooting, repair, and hardware support for RDPI automation and robotics systems at Amazon Labs, Fulfillment Centers (FCs) and Sortation Centers (SCs) across North America



Execute and support SAT, DVT, and functional testing activities in both lab (BOS35) and field environments, working alongside Test Technicians, Test Engineers, and Hardware Design Engineers.

Identify, analyze, and resolve mechanical, electrical, and electro-mechanical system issues across the RDPI hardware product suite (USP, Olympus, Gen14, Velocity and emerging platforms)

Design and implement electro-mechanical tools, fixtures, and diagnostic solutions to minimize troubleshooting time and reduce machine downtime

Develop and implement proactive monitoring tools and methods to measure safety, reliability, and performance of RDPI hardware systems in the field

Create escalation processes, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and preventative maintenance protocols for RDPI hardware

Conduct root cause analysis (RCA) and failure investigations, documenting findings and driving corrective actions back to the HW development and test engineering teams

Design and lead training sessions and develop training content for on-site test technicians and site Reliability & Maintenance Engineering (RME) teams

Develop and implement spare parts management recommendations and processes for field-deployed RDPI hardware

Produce performance reports and provide "voice of the field" feedback to HW development, test engineering, and program teams

Oversee and provide technical guidance to Test Technicians during field deployments, ensuring adherence to test plans and safety protocols

Partner with site-level RME teams to maximize RDPI hardware system performance during and after testing campaigns

Up to 75% travel expected

A day in the life
As a Hardware Support Engineer on the RDPI GE HW Field Service team, your day begins by reviewing system performance data and field test reports from active deployment sites. Perhaps overnight testing at a New Jersey FC revealed an intermittent sensor fault on a USP machine, or a part failed at a New York site and a spare is not available. You analyze metrics to identify trends and risks, developing de-risking actions for the weekly business review with your Test Manager.

You troubleshoot remotely with on-site test technicians via video, walking them through diagnostic procedures for an electro-mechanical issue. Later that morning, you travel to an active testing site to conduct a hardware audit on a newly deployed Olympus system, gathering feedback from the site RME team and coordinating with the Test Engineer who owns the test plan.

In the afternoon, you're hands-on with the hardware—swapping a suspect actuator assembly, running functional checks, and documenting your findings in a detailed failure investigation report. You design a quick diagnostic fixture to help technicians isolate a recurring conveyor alignment issue more efficiently. Before wrapping up, you coordinate with the BOS35 Test Manager and Supervisor on the next week's field deployment schedule, update your SOPs based on lessons learned, and present a root cause summary to the HW development team that will influence the next design iteration.

We are open to hiring candidates to work out of: Boston, MA (BOS35) with up to 75% travel required to Amazon Fulfillment Centers and Sortation Centers across North America.

About the team
Our GE HW Field Service Tech team is part of the RDPI Global Engineering Hardware Engineering organization. We operate in a highly collaborative, multi-disciplinary environment working alongside hardware engineers, software engineers, controls engineers, reliability engineers, test engineers, and operations teams. Our field service team provides critical hands-on support to ensure RDPI hardware platforms perform reliably during testing, validation, and deployment across Amazon's fulfillment network.

We focus on bridging the gap between lab-based development and real-world field performance—our team is the eyes, ears, and hands of the HW Test Engineering organization in the field. We work backwards from the technician and site operator experience to identify hardware deficiencies, communicate risk, and propose mitigation strategies. Our hands-on approach to testing, troubleshooting, and investigating puts us in the shoes of operators and technicians in the field. We work backwards from these insights to satisfy engineering requirements, partnering with safety, hardware, software, controls, and cross-functional support teams.

Our work spans the entire product development lifecycle—from early design verification and factory acceptance through site acceptance testing and continuous improvement of deployed systems across hundreds of fulfillment centers in North America. What sets our team apart is our direct, hands-on engagement with the hardware at scale, ensuring our automation solutions deliver exceptional performance, reliability, and quality. Our contributions directly impact Amazon's sustainability goals, operational efficiency, and the customer experience for millions of packages shipped daily.

We're responsible for field support of diverse automation technologies including Universal SmartPac (USP), EcoPac, Assisted Bagging, URL-SLAM, UIS 2.0 (Universal Item Sortation), ASAD (Automatic Scanning at Dock Door), Olympus, Gen14, and emerging Pack Assist technologies.

Basic qualifications

- Experience managing lab resources, equipment, and supplies

Preferred qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, or related STEM discipline (or equivalent hands-on experience)
- Experience in field service, commissioning, or site acceptance testing of industrial automation, robotics, or packaging machinery
- Experience with hardware functional testing (L1–L4), design verification testing (DVT), and factory/site acceptance testing (FAT/SAT)
- Experience designing electro-mechanical diagnostic tools, fixtures, or jigs to support troubleshooting
- Experience developing standard operating procedures (SOPs), preventative maintenance protocols, or training content for technical teams
- Experience with root cause analysis methodologies (5-Why, Fishbone, 8D, etc.)

title: Mechanical Integration Leader, OMHS
descriptionHtml:
Amazon is seeking a Mechanical Integration Lead to drive the successful installation, integration, and deployment of material handling equipment (MHE) across multiple greenfield and brownfield fulfillment center sites. This role provides hands-on mechanical engineering leadership in complex automation environments, ensuring projects meet Amazon's safety, timeline, cost, and quality standards. The Mechanical Integration Lead will directly manage mechanical installation crews deploying conveyor systems, sortation equipment, and associated structural systems across North America. Reporting to the Site Deployment Manager, you will lead sub-teams responsible for structural steel installation, conveyor prep and placement, mechanical connections and belting, side guide and netting installation, pneumatic systems, and mechanical quality control and commissioning. You will collaborate across engineering, supply chain, and operations to implement scalable solutions, resolve technical issues in the field, and deliver high-impact results across large, multi-site programs.

Key job responsibilities
Mechanical Installation Leadership:
• Directly manage and lead mechanical installation crews deploying MHE across North American facilities
• Oversee structural header steel installation including hanging steel, prebuilding supports, and anchoring to building structure
• Lead conveyor prep and placement operations — rigging, lifting, staging, and setting conveyor sections into final positions on installed supports
• Manage conveyor connections and belting crews — ensuring proper mechanical alignment, bed connections, squaring, leveling, and hardware tightening
• Direct side guide and netting installation ensuring proper alignment and tension
• Oversee belt crew operations including belting and lacing installation on aligned conveyor sections
• Manage pneumatic/air systems installation including air connections to conveyor components, pressure testing, and leak verification
• Coordinate with the logistics and receiving team to ensure materials are inventoried, staged, and distributed to work zones on schedule

Quality Control & Commissioning:
• Lead mechanical QC and commissioning activities including alignment verification, hardware inspections, and match-mark verification
• Oversee conveyor run-in testing, belt tracking verification, and belt tension checks
• Manage mechanical punch list identification and repair
• Verify IOQ checks and ensure all mechanical systems meet specifications before handoff to electrical teams
• Ensure proper match-marking of nuts/bolts to verify tightness across all connections

Technical Leadership & Standards:
• Provide mechanical engineering expertise for automation initiatives across assigned sites
• Implement technical solutions and lead project-level decisions within the mechanical scope
• Follow and help develop mechanical installation standards and best practices
• Create and maintain technical documentation including work instructions, installation SOPs, and QC checklists
• Participate in design reviews and drive mechanical engineering excellence
• Recommend and implement process improvements to increase installation efficiency and quality

Project Execution & Coordination:
• Lead delivery of complex mechanical installation projects with multi-site impact
• Work cross-functionally with engineering, supply chain, and operations teams
• Coordinate with the electrical integration lead to ensure proper sequencing — mechanical work must be complete in each zone before electrical teams
mobilize
• Manage relationships with mechanical vendors and partners
• Provide technical input to leadership for data-driven decision-making
• Drive achievement of safety, timeline, cost, and quality metrics across assigned zones
• Participate in daily business reviews with installation progress updates

A day in the life
As a Mechanical Integration Lead, you start your day with the site coordination meeting, reviewing progress against the installation schedule and identifying any material or sequencing issues with your crews. From there, you're on the construction
floor — walking zones with your structural steel team verifying header hanger loads, checking that the conveyor prep and placement crew has the right sections staged, and ensuring the connections team is properly aligning and torquing hardware. You troubleshoot rigging challenges, coordinate with the Site Operations Leader on material deliveries, and validate that mechanical QC checks are passed before handing zones off to the electrical team. You close out by updating job plans, flagging risks for the daily business review, and planning tomorrow's crew assignments, ratios, and confirming proper routing around obstructions. You oversee wire pulling operations in active zones, ensuring proper cable sizing, bend radius compliance, and pull tension limits are respected. Mid-morning you inspect control panel placements, verifying mounting locations match drawings, checking clearance requirements, and confirming grounding connections. You validate junction box and disconnect installations, review wire terminations for proper torque values and labeling, and address any field conflicts that require engineering clarification. By afternoon, you're tracking installation progress against the schedule, coordinating with the device installation lead on upcoming zone handoffs, and documenting redlines for as-built updates. You close out at the daily business review with progress updates and flag any material or access risks for the next day.

About the team
The OMHS Installation & Deployment team supports the deployment and integration of automation and material handling systems across Amazon's operations network. The team works cross-functionally with engineering, construction, operations, supply chain, vendors, and field execution partners to deliver safe, scalable, and reliable systems.

Basic qualifications

- Experience in engineering including a supervisory role managing people
- Experience in a fast-paced, automated, industrial, logistics, production or manufacturing environment
- 5+ years of experience in industrial engineering, operations engineering, manufacturing engineering, or project engineering in a manufacturing or construction environment
- Experience in a supervisory role managing installation crews, maintenance technicians, or tradespeople
- Experience with the project management of technical projects in fast-paced, automated industrial environments
- Experience delivering technical projects in active construction environments
- Ability to travel up to 50% domestically; travel may exceed 50% in some instances with short notice
- Ability to read and understand installation drawings

Preferred qualifications

- Prior experience managing millwrights, maintenance technicians, fabricators, ironworkers, riggers, pipefitters, or aircraft mechanics
- Prior experience working for a material handling integrator
- Prior experience installing conveyor or sortation systems
- Experience with rigging, crane operations, and heavy equipment placement
- Experience with structural steel installation and load verification
- Knowledge of AutoCAD, BIM 360, or equivalent CAD software
- Experience working with and managing third-party vendors and subcontractors
- Experience with Six Sigma, lean manufacturing, or continuous improvement methodologies
- Experience with pneumatic systems installation and testing
- PMP or other project management certification

title: Finance Manager, Fulfillment by Amazon - AI Native Finance Analytics & Controls
descriptionHtml:
Fulfillment By Amazon (FBA) Finance is seeking a Finance Manager who can do two things simultaneously: ensure the integrity of Amazon's largest seller fee revenue base AND turn that clean data foundation into profitability intelligence that drives fee strategy decisions.

This is not a traditional finance role — it's a hybrid that combines end-to-end FBA analytics and how we protect our fee revenue base, heavily powered by AI and automation,

You will own the connection between FBA fee revenue at the shipment level and operational costs across Amazon's fulfillment network — producing the fee-level P&L that tells leadership whether we're happy or sad with FBA economics and that our financial controls are working. You'll also own the GL reconciliation, revenue assurance, and quarterly inspection mechanisms that ensure those numbers are trustworthy. The controllership work is the foundation; the analytics work is the payoff.
This role sits at the intersection of all fee verticals, providing the consolidated profitability view that no single vertical can see alone. You'll partner across FP&A, Fee Strategy, Fee Technology, and Accounting.

The vision: Within 6 months, 80%+ of the controllership inspection work is automated through AI agents and intelligent workflows. Your time shifts from manual reconciliation to proactive anomaly detection, cross-fee profitability analysis, and producing the analytics that shape FBA's fee strategy.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the end-to-end fee-level P&L: connect FBA revenue (by fee type, ASP band, size tier) to operational costs across the fulfillment network
- Build and maintain AI-powered variance decomposition and profitability reporting across fee activities (Supply Chain, Storage, Selling, Value Recovery)
- Perform key GL reconciliations to ensure complete, accurate, and timely financial reporting across multiple marketplaces
- Design and automate controllership inspection mechanisms — shifting from reactive audit to proactive, AI-driven anomaly detection
- Partner with Fee Strategy, Accounting, and Fee Technology teams to ensure fees are accurate, timely, and aligned with seller communication and internal strategy
- Deliver recurring revenue analytics with proactive signals for leadership; produce cross-fee margin analysis that informs fee strategy decisions
- Build AI agents and automated workflows targeting significant automation of routine controllership inspections — develop repeatable patterns the broader finance team can adopt
- Perform recurring and ad-hoc audits of fee revenues; manage seller transaction adjustments and revenue assurance
- Provide support for external/internal audit inquiries; act as subject matter expert for controllership and FBA profitability analytics


A day in the life
Your morning starts with an AI-generated anomaly report you built — replacing hours of manual reconciliation. You investigate a fee variance, trace it to a calculation edge case, and partner with Fee Tech to resolve it before close. By afternoon, you're building the monthly fee-level P&L, decomposing variances into rate and mix effects, and drafting the narrative for leadership. Between deep dives, you're refining automated workflows that turn weekly controllership checks from multi-hour manual pulls into minutes-with-exceptions. You hold both lenses — "are the numbers right?" and "what do they mean?" — which makes you the person leadership trusts for both.

About the team
You will be joining a high-performing, fast-paced Finance team whose mission is to be the trusted strategic advisor to the business, driving profitable growth and scale through innovation. Is a highly visible role within the finance team and requires a strong leader and open communicator. You will have direct impact on top and bottom lines with the ability to deliver improvements for our teams. You will be part of a growing, fast paced, and fun team. You will have ownership for the implementation of your work and you will see direct business improvements based on the results of your work.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of finance, accounting, or related analytical field experience
- Bachelor's degree in business, finance, accounting, tax, economics, or a related analytical field
- 5+ years of leading cross-functional initiatives that drive financial performance and strategy experience
- 5+ years of dissecting financial data and identifying patterns that support business strategy experience

Preferred qualifications

- 6+ years of identifying incomplete or inaccurate data, identifying the root cause and creating/implementing an escalation plan experience
- 6+ years of solving complex business challenges by delivering accurate and timely financial models, analysis, and recommendations that have a proven impact on business (e.g., financial savings, operational improvements, or customer benefits) experience
- MBA, or CPA
- Knowledge of SQL/ETL
- Experience working with large-scale data mining and reporting tools (examples: SQL, MS Access, Essbase, Cognos) and other financial systems (examples: Oracle, SAP, Lawson, JD Edwards)
- Experience delivering forecasting, budgeting, and variance analysis, and data interpretation of results

descriptionHtml:

- Participate in training and certification to facilitate first aid, CPR and AED certifications classes.
- Maintain all first aid, CPR, AED credentials.
- Work flexible shifts which could include days, nights, holidays, and/or weekends.
- Assist with random saliva drug testing protocols.
- Maintain effective care delivery in emergencies and assist emergency response at the site.

Additional Job Elements include:

You will have a holistic view of material procurement, vendor operations, and installation logistics across NASC, DC, and CH networks — and be integral in driving large-scale initiatives in material cost optimization, vendor management, PO reconciliation, and installation capacity planning. With a deployment target spanning thousands of doors across multiple networks and fiscal years, there will rarely be a perfect solution — it will be up to you to make data-driven decisions and manage complex vendor and cross-functional stakeholder relationships while planning and executing within a rapidly evolving program.

title: Engineering Operation Technician
descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic team and become a critical guardian of technological infrastructure! As a Data Center Engineering Technician, you'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of mission-critical technology infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that power global digital experiences. Your expertise will directly contribute to maintaining an extraordinary 99.999% uptime, keeping the digital world running smoothly and efficiently.

Engineering Technicians are Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot, Data Center Operation’s Mission Critical Facilities, which includes stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, as well as three phase electrical systems such as: switch gear, UPSs, PDUs, wet cell batteries and associated systems, CRAC, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical system, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, & motors.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.
NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.


Key job responsibilities
- Daily building rounds to monitor and record information from electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment to ensure 24/7 reliability and availability
- Monitor Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Management System (EPMS)
- Assist in troubleshooting of facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA)
- Perform rack installs and rack decommissioning within internal SLA
- Perform PM, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and repair of electrical and mechanical equipment
- Technical writing to support change management program
- Monitor daily work requests and manage to resolution, and execute projects from conception to completion
- On-site support of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation
- Work schedule changes depending on specific site needs. Shifts can be up to 12 hours and may rotate on a predefined schedule. Some locations have on-call rotations.
- Role may support more than one location/site.

Physical Requirements:
- Willingness and demonstrated ability to work in the following physical conditions with reasonable accommodations:
- Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds independently
- Participate in group lifts for 40+ pounds
- Maintain balance and perform construction tasks while on a ladder
- Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, climb stairs, twist, bend, work above shoulders, grasp, carry, push and pull objects into position
- Work in an environment requiring provided ear protection

This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements:
- Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed
- Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational
- Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility

Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs

A day in the life
This role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment preventative maintenance (PM) and troubleshooting, reporting to a site’s Data Center Facility Manager (FM). title: Senior Software Development Engineer, IMDb Discovery Services
descriptionHtml:
Design and build the search, ranking, and list systems behind IMDb - the platform hundreds of millions of people use to find movies, shows, and talent. As a senior engineer, you'll own the architecture for core areas of discovery and lead the work to turn these systems into an AI-powered discovery engine built on IMDb's structured data: titles, people, credits, and the relationships between them.

- Own distributed services handling billions of requests across imdb.com, amazon.com, and partner channels
- Lead development and strategy of key system features on IMDb's Discovery platforms, driving intent-based search and AI/ML-powered ranking
- Set engineering standards, mentor engineers, and own your services end to end in production

IMDb is the world's most popular source for information on movies, TV shows, and celebrities. IMDb Discovery Services builds the search, list, and ranking platform that helps hundreds of millions of customers find, explore, and connect with the titles and talent they care about. We own real-time suggestion search across imdb.com, amazon.com, and affiliated domains; main and advanced search; charts and discovery widgets; the user list platform; and the ranking systems behind STARmeter, MOVIEmeter, and TVmeter. These services handle billions of requests and sit at the heart of the IMDb experience, powering IMDb Consumer, IMDbPro, and a growing set of partner and AI-assistant channels.

We're evolving this platform into an AI-native discovery engine: intelligent retrieval that understands intent, lists that surface as a discovery experience rather than personal storage, and self-service integration so downstream teams onboard through typed SDKs and versioned contracts. Our search stack is built on AWS OpenSearch Service, and relevance, latency, and scale are first-class engineering concerns. Every generative and agentic experience is grounded in IMDb's structured entity graph of titles, names, credits, and verified relationships — data no competitor has at this depth.

As a Senior Software Development Engineer (SDE) on this team, you'll own architecture for one or more of these areas, lead multi-engineer efforts where the customer problem is clear but the technical strategy is not, and set the engineering standard others build to. The work sits at the intersection of large-scale distributed systems, information retrieval and machine learning, and a uniquely valuable data set.


Key job responsibilities
- Lead the development and technical strategy of key system features for IMDb's search platform on AWS OpenSearch Service - index design, relevance tuning, query performance, and scaling.
- Own the architecture for a significant area of the discovery platform (search/retrieval, ranking, or the list platform), providing a system-wide view and design guidance across the team.
- Lead the design and delivery of complex, multi-engineer projects end to end - scoping, design, implementation, testing, deployment, and operations - breaking work into parallel streams and integrating it into a coherent whole.
- Build intelligent retrieval and ML-powered ranking, plus platform capabilities (API contracts, versioned SLOs, typed SDKs) for downstream and AI-agent consumers.
- Raise the operational bar: own alarms, telemetry, runbooks, and COE practices, balancing velocity against reliability on the critical path.
- Review designs and code across the team to ensure solutions are well-designed, extensible, performant, and secure; drive adoption of engineering best practices.
- Identify and resolve architecture deficiencies and systemic operational issues, including those where the platform bottlenecks other teams' innovation.
- Mentor engineers and partner with product and program management to shape the discovery roadmap.
- Contribute to AI-native platform practices - steering files, structured knowledge, and agent-readable interfaces for your codebases.

A day in the life
You might open the day reviewing a ranking-signal design and a teammate's pull request, then spend the morning on a thorny retrieval problem - tuning OpenSearch analyzers and query structure so intent resolves against the entity graph. After lunch you meet a partner team onboarding to your search SDK and refine the contract, then write code on the critical path. You close by triaging a signal from the suggestion-search pipeline and updating a runbook. The role moves between deep engineering, design leadership, and operational ownership - often in the same day.

About the team
We own four areas: (1) search and retrieval across IMDb, amazon.com, and affiliated domains; (2) the list platform, growing into a discovery surface with ranking, tagging, and social features; (3) trust - correctness, moderation, and multi-region reliability to published SLOs; and (4) a self-service platform layer that product teams integrate without manual support. Consumers include IMDb Consumer, IMDbPro, and partner and AI-assistant channels. We're building these systems into an AI-native discovery engine grounded in IMDb's structured entity graph - titles, names, credits, and verified relationships no competitor has at this depth.

Basic qualifications

- 6+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 6+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience
- 6+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team

Preferred qualifications

- 6+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
- Experience building search, discovery, ranking, recommendation, or information retrieval systems at scale
- Hands-on experience with AWS OpenSearch Service, Elasticsearch, or similar search technologies, including index design, mappings, analyzers, query optimization, relevance tuning, sharding, and cluster performance
- Experience with GraphQL, REST APIs, or similar API technologies, and building platform/self-service integration paths (typed SDKs, versioned contracts)

title: Software Development Engineer, Devices Software & Services
descriptionHtml:
The Amazon Devices Software & Services team is looking for a Software Development Engineer to join a high-velocity, specialized team. This is not a traditional framework or infrastructure role - we are building a new groundbreaking customer experience that will define how millions of users worldwide interact with their technology - making it more proactive, intuitive, and invisible.

We’re building the systems that put AI into production — the runtime, services, and tooling that turn large language models and autonomous agents into reliable, safe, scalable products. As a Software Development Engineer II, you’ll design and ship core software in this stack: model and tool integrations, the agent execution loop, evaluation and quality pipelines, and the APIs that product teams build on. You’ll own meaningful components end to end, make real design decisions, and write production code that runs against real users and real data.
This is a hands-on building role for an engineer who wants to go deep on AI infrastructure — not just call an API, but engineer the reliability, safety, and performance around it. You’ll also work in an AI-native development environment: we use AI coding assistants and agentic workflows as part of our daily software-development lifecycle, and we hold that velocity to a hard bar of automated testing and code review. We expect engineers who can move fast and keep the quality gates green.


Key job responsibilities
- Invent New Paradigms: Move beyond traditional voice UI to build "Ambient Intelligence" experiences that span Alexa, Fire TV, and mobile/wearable surfaces, focusing on proactive assistance rather than reactive commands.
- Rapid Innovation: Operate in a fast-paced environment where you will prototype, test, and deploy features that leverage multimodal inputs (camera, audio, and documents) to create personalized customer magic.
- Cross-Surface Continuity: Ensure that a customer’s experience is persistent and context-aware beyond the device boundaries - whether they are at their desk using Alexa.com, in their living room with Fire TV, or on the go with a wearable.
- Design, build, test, and operate scalable backend services and libraries that power AI/LLM-driven features.
- Integrate and harden model providers, tools, and agent capabilities behind clean, versioned interfaces — with sane failure behavior, observability, and cost/latency awareness.

title: Infra Quality Engineer, (Infrastructure Reliability & Quality Engineer)
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

The AWS Field Engineering organization provides engineering support for our data centers throughout their lifecycle. A critical piece of this support is ensuring the highest level of initial quality and ongoing support from our vendors. As an Infra Quality Engineer you will interface daily with AWS Engineering teams, Procurement teams, and vendors to manage infrastructure equipment quality. Our Infra Quality Engineer is responsible for supplier qualifications, quality monitoring at supplier sites, supplier quality issue resolution and supplier development and quality improvement initiatives.

If you want to be a part of a team that has a daily impact on company success, this is a great opportunity for you.

In this role you will lead internal and external engagements with engineering, procurement, supply chain management, operations, finance, construction, and suppliers to deliver robust and resilient quality systems at our vendors and within AWS. You will identify supplier quality defects or waste in AWS processes, and drive new processes to eliminate the defects and prevent them from recurring without posing risk to availability.

In this role your responsibilities include:
• Develop, implement and maintain the Supplier Quality roadmap for complex electrical and or mechanical infrastructure equipment to meet the technical and quality requirements.
• Manage complete equipment lifecycle quality, working closely with suppliers, engineering, procurement and other internal stakeholders.
• Responsible for improving equipment quality by identifying and closing gaps by performing thorough on-site audits to ensure suppliers' quality systems, products, and processes are meeting AWS Quality and product specification requirements.
• Drive Supplier Quality Improvement Programs track supplier performance along with goal settings for key performance indicators.
• Develop critical to quality parameters, perform critical-to-quality inspections and functional testing for complex equipment to ensure suppliers provide defect-free, high quality equipment to AWS and its customers.
• Review historical failures, equipment design changes and lessons learned to incorporate relevant inspections & tests and update equipment technical specifications.
• Lead complex electrical and mechanical infrastructure equipment as well as critical component(s) root cause analysis, working with suppliers, cross-functional teams such as reliability and design engineering teams.
• Responsible for evaluating and validating complex root cause analysis reports from a technical perspective using critical thinking and quality principles.
• Develop new product (equipment) and/or new supplier qualification plans in terms of quality. Drive the quality program from prototyping to mass production stage for complex electrical and mechanical equipment that are part of AWS Data Centers.
• Ability to perform data analysis on failures reported during the equipment life cycle and create technical reports to provide design and specification improvement inputs and to drive improvement(s) at supplier factories.
• Work on concurrent projects, sometimes in multiple geographical regions.
• Demonstrate a can-do attitude and thriving in a fast-paced work environment.
• Keys to success in this role include sound judgment and excellent written and verbal communication skills.
• This role requires 30-50% international and domestic travel.

About the team
Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

- Knowledge of Microsoft Office including Outlook, Word, and Excel
- Experience in industrial or commercial engineering in mission critical facilities including but not limited to: data centers, power generation or oil and gas facilities

descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is Amazon's Low Earth Orbit satellite network, built to deliver fast, reliable internet to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. The AI Foundations team builds AI agents that turn Leo's best troubleshooting expertise into diagnoses in minutes instead of hours, helping keep the network available for every customer.

As a Software Development Engineer on AI Foundations, you will design and build production agentic systems on AWS that reason over real satellite, ground, and network data. You will work directly with principal, Sr. Principal engineers and network operators, and your work will shape how Leo is operated at scale.

Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Key job responsibilities

- Turn proven engineering tools and data sources into reusable agent tools so teams across Leo can build on them.
- Build evaluation harnesses that measure agent accuracy, coverage, and latency, and use them to gate launches.
- Own your services in production: on-call, operational metrics, root-cause analysis, and security reviews.
- Partner with principal engineers, operators, and program managers to turn ambiguous problems into shipped features.
- Write clear design docs, give thoughtful code reviews, and help teammates adopt agentic development practices.

A day in the life
You might start the morning reviewing overnight evaluation results and spotting a class of network failures your agent misdiagnosed. You trace the gap to a missing data source, then sit down with the principal engineer who owns that subsystem to agree on how to expose their tool to the agent. After lunch you build the integration and add new test cases, then review a teammate's pull request. Late afternoon, you join an operations review where an operator walks through a real incident your agent helped resolve, and you leave with a clear next priority.

About the team
We are an AI-native team of software engineers and applied scientists in Redmond, and we move fast. We use AI in how we build, not only in what we build, so a good idea can be a working experiment the same week and a production capability the next. We think beyond how things have been done, test our ideas against real problems, and keep only what proves itself. We ship lightning fast, and we hold a high bar for quality and production readiness while doing it.

descriptionHtml:
Robotics Applied Scientist II Intern/Co-op (2027)

Are you passionate about robotics and research? Do you want to solve real customer problems through innovative technology? Do you enjoy working on scalable research and projects in a collaborative team environment? Do you want to see your science solutions directly impact millions of customers worldwide?

We’re looking for current PhD students with a passion for robotic research and applications to join us in 2027 as Robotics Applied Scientist II Interns/Co-ops to shape the future of robotics and transform automation at Amazon’s scale.

By applying to this role, you will be considered for Robotics Applied Scientist II Intern/Co-op (2027) opportunities across various Robotics teams at Amazon with different robotics research focus. Internship positions are available for multiple locations, durations (3 to 6+ months), and year-round start dates (winter, spring, summer, fall).

Join us at the forefront of Applied Science, where your contributions will shape the future of Robotics!


Key job responsibilities
As a Robotics Applied Scientist II Intern/Co-op, you will work alongside global experts to advance the state of the art in robotics and artificial intelligence, tackling innovative problems that bridge the gap between research and real-world robotics implementation to innovate and build solutions on behalf of our customers.

We are particularly interested in students with specialization and expertise in one or more of the following research areas:

- Robotics
- Artificial Intelligence
- Robotics Manipulation (e.g., robot arm, grasping, dexterous manipulation, end of arm tools/end effector)
- Autonomous Mobile Robots
- Mobile Manipulation
- Multi-Robot Coordination
- Autonomous Navigation
- Locomotion
- Motion/Path Planning
- Controls
- Perception
- Sensing
- Robot Learning
- Machine Learning
- Computer Vision
- Large Language Models (LLM), Vision-Language-Action Models (VLA), Vision-Language-Models (VLM)
- World Models
- Human-Robot Interaction
- Robotics Simulation
- Optimization
- And related!

Key responsibilities may include:
- Develop novel, scalable algorithms and/or modeling techniques that advance the state-of-the-art in science areas such as robotics, artificial intelligence, or related
- Tackle challenging, innovative research problems within robotics, artificial intelligence, or related that bridge the gap between theoretical advancement and practical robotics implementation
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to solve complex problems, and to communicate research findings clearly, leveraging your expertise in robotics, artificial intelligence, or related
- Demonstrate the ability to work independently, thrive in a fast-paced, ever-changing environment
- Leverage AI-powered tools where applicable to accelerate research, experimentation, and prototyping.

About the team
Explore Robotics Teams at Amazon

At Amazon, robotics is where innovative research meets real-world deployment. There are many different specialized robotics teams, including the few highlighted below. Learn more about Robotics at Amazon here: https://www.amazon.science/research-areas/robotics

Fulfillment Technologies and Robotics
We build dynamic partnerships between people and intelligent machines. This intricate collaboration helps Amazon fulfill orders with unmatched accuracy. Working in symphony with our robotic technology, you’ll have the opportunity to extend your technical capabilities by working alongside some of the industry’s most advanced technologies. This includes our fleet of autonomous mobile robots, sophisticated control software, and technologies like language perception, machine learning, object recognition, and semantic understanding of commands. These technologies help us deliver an ever-improving customer and employee experience, as well as improve the safety of our facilities.

Amazon Robotics
Amazon Robotics is at the epicenter of robotics innovation. We design, test, and build mobile robots and mechatronic systems. Our offices, labs, test floors, and factories are close together, which means we can design the hardware, write the code, test, build, and watch it all come to life. Our areas of focus include advancements in autonomous mobility, AI, robotic management software, and much more.

Fauna
Fauna is focused on building capable, safe, and genuinely delightful robots for everyday life. Fauna’s goal is simple: make robots people actually want to live and interact with everyday. Fauna develops tightly integrated hardware and software systems that make it faster, safer, and more intuitive to create real-world robotic products. Fauna’s work spans the full stack: mechanical design, control systems, dynamic modeling, and intelligent software. The focus is not just functionality, but overall experience.

Amazon Fulfillment Technologies develops tech solutions that create network optimizations for all Amazon sites worldwide. We own network infrastructure and devices in all buildings and labor planning and scheduling technology for fulfillment centers in North America and Europe.

descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Amazon Web Services is hiring a Senior Product Design Mechanical Engineer with diesel generator experience for our Electrical Products and Services team. The Electrical Products and Services Team is a AWS's Data Center Engineering global engineering team, responsible for the design and continuous innovation for products used within our rapidly expanding data center footprint.

The Electrical Products and Services team works to design and develop resilient, cost-effective electrical distribution products and systems. As an engineer at Amazon, we are responsible for achieving world class uptime for our customers. We drive continuous advancements and improvements with our designs and communicate technical direction to Senior Leadership. We seek new ways to enhance the reliability, scalability, and cost effectiveness of our engineering designs. As an engineer at Amazon, you can design, innovate, and improve the products our customers rely on.

Amazon offers a fast-paced, fun, and exciting work environment. We continue to grow at exponential rates and are looking for individuals that can support our speed to market, enjoy a challenge, and have a desire for professional growth and continuous learning experiences. Amazon’s work environment is unique in every aspect and offers an exceptional opportunity for the right candidate.

If you are a natural leader, smart and worked with high performing team of engineers that enjoys working with complex problems we want you! At Amazon, you will be responsible for working on product designs and supporting our wide variety of customers. Great ideas are encouraged and supported. Ingenuity is the main mechanism which supports our focus on quality, speed, and cost.

At Amazon, teamwork is absolutely necessary for us to accomplish our goals. You must be able to work within a team and depend on others to accomplish the required work. As a product engineer at Amazon, you will be working with other internal groups as well as external groups including engineering service providers, manufacturers, vendors, inspectors, third party testing labs and contractors.

Amazon has a global presence. Travel will be necessary but shouldn’t be more than 30%. International support will be part of the job, and some international travel may be necessary. Your contribution could consist of leading international projects and could require developing engineering information packages. An understanding of international electrical or mechanical product design requirements is helpful but not necessary.

title: Asset Manager, Global Realty Portfolio Management
descriptionHtml:
Application deadline: Nov 18, 2026

Shape the physical backbone of Amazon's delivery network. As an Asset Manager with Portfolio Management, you'll own the real estate lifecycle for the buildings that get packages to customers — managing a portfolio of 90–120 fulfillment, sortation, and delivery facilities across your region of North America.

This is a high-impact, high-visibility role for a self-starter who thrives on autonomy, relationship-building, and solving complex real estate challenges at scale. You'll be the face of Amazon to our landlord partners and the owner of lease compliance across your portfolio.

Why you'll love it here:

- Own a meaningful portfolio with real autonomy and decision-making authority
- Work at the intersection of real estate, operations, and one of the world's most dynamic logistics networks
- Join a collaborative, people-first team that invests in your growth
- Travel: Travel is required (25% or less) within your assigned region for property inspections, resolving real estate challenges, and strengthening relationships between Amazon and our landlord partners. Occasional travel to Amazon hubs in Seattle, WA; Nashville, TN; Arlington, VA; or Miami, FL will be required for team meetings and company events.

Key job responsibilities
What you'll do:

- Manage a regional portfolio of 90–120 leased and owned operations locations across the full asset lifecycle
- Drive lease compliance by implementing Amazon and industry best practices across your sites
- Build and maintain strong landlord relationships — you'll be Amazon's primary point of contact
- Solve complex real estate challenges by partnering across diverse internal and external stakeholder groups
- Combine real estate expertise with sharp problem-solving to protect and optimize Amazon's interests


A day in the life
No two days look the same in Asset Management. You might start your morning reviewing lease compliance obligations across your portfolio, then jump on a call with a landlord to resolve a maintenance dispute or negotiate a site condition issue. Midday could find you on the road, conducting a property inspection at one of your fulfillment, sortation, or delivery sites — walking the building, documenting conditions, and spotting risks before they become problems. In the afternoon, you'll partner with internal stakeholders across operations, facilities, finance, and legal to solve complex real estate challenges and keep your sites running smoothly. Throughout it all, you're the owner of your region — making decisions, building relationships, and protecting Amazon's interests across 90–120 locations. You'll balance competing priorities, think on your feet, and apply both real estate expertise and sharp problem-solving to every situation. If you're energized by autonomy, variety, and real ownership of a meaningful portfolio, this is the role for you.

About the team
You'll join the Portfolio Management team within Amazon's Global Operations & Engineering Services (GOES) organization — the group responsible for managing the real estate assets behind Amazon's North America operations network. Our mission is to protect and optimize the buildings that move packages to customers, spanning fulfillment centers, sortation centers, delivery stations, and the supporting infrastructure that keeps the network running. We own the full asset lifecycle — lease administration and compliance, landlord relationship management, site condition assessments, capital planning, and portfolio optimization — bringing real estate discipline and industry best practices to one of the world's most dynamic logistics networks. We're a collaborative, people-first team that invests in developing our people, distributes work thoughtfully, and gives every team member real ownership of their region. If you want to make a measurable impact on how Amazon manages its physical footprint — and grow alongside a team that values autonomy, problem-solving, and continuous improvement — this is where you'll do it.

- Demonstrated use of AI tools and automation to improve productivity, streamline workflows, or scale institutional knowledge

Preferred qualifications

- Experience reading and interpreting construction drawings and specifications
- Experience working in fast paced environments, and managing workload even during times of stress, or escalated activity
- Can work proactively and independently, meet deadlines, and deliver on projects and tasks

title: Pricing Analyst
descriptionHtml:
Here at Amazon, we're seeking for an experienced Program Manager to lead our pricing initiatives for the Delivery Service Partner (DSP) program in India. In this key role, you will be responsible for developing and implementing pricing strategies that maximize profitability for both the AMZL and DSP partners while ensuring competitiveness in the last-mile delivery market. You will be developing cost-effective pricing models while maintaining service quality in the rapidly evolving e-commerce delivery landscape.

Key Responsibilities:
• Analyze last-mile delivery costs, including labor, fuel, vehicle expenses, and regional variations and build cluster pricing to remain competitive.
• Develop and maintain dynamic pricing models for various delivery options (same-day, next-day, scheduled) across different delivery windows.
• Monitor and optimize pricing strategies for different zones, time slots, and delivery types balancing capacity resilience, competitiveness and cost to serve.
• Analyze competitor pricing and market trends in the last-mile delivery and build fluidic models to generate proposals within short timelines.
• Generate various what if scenarios and present recommendations for operational leaders to make a informed decision.
• Evaluate the impact of peak periods, seasonal fluctuations, and special events on pricing and incorporate the same in quarterly guidance.
• Collaborate with operations teams to understand delivery constraints and capacity needs and support them with right flexibility levers to prioritize customer experience.
• Generate regular performance reports on pricing effectiveness, profitability, capacity sufficiency, DA earning and evolving market trends.

Required Qualifications:
• Bachelor's degree in Business, Economics, Supply Chain Management, or related field
